<script>
  // Guard to ensure wf and wf.ready exist before running
  if (typeof wf !== 'undefined' && typeof wf.ready === 'function') {
    wf.ready(() => {
      const handleWebflowAnalyticsConsent = () => {
        try {
          // Logic to check consent groups from the OneTrust cookie
          const otCookieKey = 'OptanonConsent=';
          const otCookie = document.cookie.split('; ').find((row) => row.startsWith(otCookieKey));
          if (!otCookie) {
            throw new Error('OneTrust cookie not found.');
          }

          const otGroupsKey = 'groups=';
          const otGroups = decodeURIComponent(
            otCookie
              .split('&')
              .find((row) => row.startsWith(otGroupsKey))
              .split('=')[1],
          );

          // OneTrust groups: 1 = necessary, 2 = performance, 3 = functional, 4 = targeting
          const OT_FUNCTIONAL_CONSENT = '3:1'; // Ensure this matches your expected consent group

          // Check for functional cookies group
          const hasOptedIn = otGroups.indexOf(OT_FUNCTIONAL_CONSENT) !== -1;

          // Adjust Webflow Analytics opt-in/out based on consent
          if (typeof wf.allowUserTracking === 'function' && typeof wf.denyUserTracking === 'function') {
            if (hasOptedIn) {
              wf.allowUserTracking();
            } else {
              wf.denyUserTracking();
            }
          } else {
            console.warn('wf tracking methods not found.');
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.error('Error handling OneTrust consent:', e);
        }
      };

      // Set up the OneTrust consent change listener
      if (typeof OneTrust !== 'undefined' && typeof OneTrust.OnConsentChanged === 'function') {
        OneTrust.OnConsentChanged(() => {
          handleWebflowAnalyticsConsent();
        });
      }

      // Initial check when the page loads
      handleWebflowAnalyticsConsent();
    });
  } else {
    console.warn('wf or wf.ready is not defined yet. Skipping analytics consent setup.');
  }

(function () {
  const DOMScript = document.currentScript;

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const DOM = {
      wrapper: DOMScript.closest('.kat26-navbar-modal-container'),
      close: false,
      search: {
        form: false,
        input: false,
        trigger: false,
        clear: false,
      },
      trigger: false
    };

    if (!DOM.wrapper) {
      return;
    }

    DOM.close = DOM.wrapper.querySelector('.search__close');

    DOM.search.form = DOM.wrapper.querySelector('form');
    DOM.search.input = DOM.wrapper.querySelector('input');
    DOM.search.trigger = DOM.wrapper.querySelector('.search__trigger');
    DOM.search.clear = DOM.wrapper.querySelector('.search__clear');

    DOM.trigger = document.querySelector('.kat26-navbar-container .kat26-navbar-search-button');

    DOM.search.trigger.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
    
      DOM.search.form.submit();
    });

    DOM.search.clear.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
    
      DOM.search.input.value = '';
      DOM.search.input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
    });

    DOM.trigger.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();

      DOM.wrapper.classList.add('kat26-navbar-modal-container--active');
      DOM.search.input.focus();
    });

    DOM.close.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      DOM.wrapper.classList.remove('kat26-navbar-modal-container--active');
    });

    window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (DOM.wrapper.classList.contains('kat26-navbar-modal-container--active') && e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();

        DOM.wrapper.classList.remove('kat26-navbar-modal-container--active');
      }
    });

    DOM.wrapper.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();

      DOM.wrapper.classList.remove('kat26-navbar-modal-container--active');
    });

    DOM.wrapper.querySelector('.kat26-navbar-search-modal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
    });
  });
})();

<script>
(function () {
  const DOMScript = document.currentScript;

  function init() {
    const menuDOM = {
      wrapper: (DOMScript && DOMScript.closest('.kat26-navbar-container')) || document.querySelector('.kat26-navbar-container')
    };

    if (!menuDOM.wrapper) {
      return;
    }

    const hasGsap = typeof gsap !== 'undefined';
    const desktopQuery = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 992px)');

    // Toggle a Webflow dropdown the way Webflow expects. Its dropdown module listens on the toggle for a native
    // 'mouseup' (mouse devices) or 'click' (touch devices); jQuery's 'tap' is only an alias for click, so a
    // trigger('tap') never opens a dropdown on desktop.
    function tapToggle(DOMToggle) {
      if (!DOMToggle) {
        return;
      }

      // Webflow binds the toggle to 'mouseup' on mouse devices and to 'click' on touch devices, so send both.
      DOMToggle.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0, buttons: 1 }));
      DOMToggle.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0 }));
      DOMToggle.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0 }));
    }

    function closeOpenDropdowns(except) {
      menuDOM.wrapper.querySelectorAll('.kat26-navbar-dropdown').forEach(DOMDropdown => {
        if (DOMDropdown === except) {
          return;
        }

        tapToggle(DOMDropdown.querySelector(':scope > .w-dropdown-toggle.w--open'));
      });
    }

    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // BEGIN: Hover control (native dropdown hover suppressed; desktop hover with grace, mobile tap-only)
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    (function () {
      const GRACE_MS = 180; // Used to prevent "instant" menu opens
      let timer = null; // This is a global timer

      // Verify if there's a current open nav
      function hasOpenNav() {
        return menuDOM.wrapper.querySelectorAll('.w--open').length !== 0;
      }

      menuDOM.wrapper.querySelectorAll('.kat26-navbar-dropdown').forEach(DOMDropdown => {
        const DOMToggle = DOMDropdown.querySelector(':scope > .w-dropdown-toggle');

        if (!DOMToggle) {
          return;
        }

        function setOpen() {
          if (!DOMToggle.classList.contains('w--open')) {
            closeOpenDropdowns(DOMDropdown);
            tapToggle(DOMToggle);
          }
        }

        // Webflow binds its own hover open/close through jQuery mouseenter/mouseleave, which jQuery
        // implements on mouseover/mouseout. Stop those at the wrapper (capture phase) so the native
        // hover never fires: below 992px the drawer becomes tap-only, above it the handlers below take over
        // with a grace period. Native mouseenter/mouseleave used here are unaffected.
        ['mouseover', 'mouseout'].forEach(type => {
          DOMDropdown.addEventListener(type, function (e) {
            e.stopImmediatePropagation();
          }, true);
        });

        DOMDropdown.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () {
          if (!desktopQuery.matches) {
            return;
          }

          clearTimeout(timer);

          // Do not wait, open immediately
          if (hasOpenNav()) {
            setOpen();
            // Wait for a few MS to avoid unintended menu opens
          } else {
            timer = setTimeout(() => {
              setOpen();
            }, GRACE_MS);
          }
        });

        DOMDropdown.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
          if (!desktopQuery.matches) {
            return;
          }

          clearTimeout(timer);

          if (DOMToggle.classList.contains('w--open')) {
            tapToggle(DOMToggle);
          }

        });
      });
    })();
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // END: Hover control
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // BEGIN: Menu Interaction
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    (function () {
      if (!hasGsap) {
        return;
      }

      const buttonDOM = {
        nav: {
          toggles: menuDOM.wrapper.querySelectorAll('.w-dropdown-toggle')
        }
      };
      const matchMedia = gsap.matchMedia();

      matchMedia.add('(min-width: 992px)', () => {
        const hoverHandlers = [];

        buttonDOM.nav.toggles.forEach(DOMToggle => {
          const DOMSubNav = DOMToggle.parentElement.querySelector('.w-dropdown-list');
          const timeline = gsap.timeline();
          const observer = new MutationObserver((mutationList) => {
            mutationList.forEach(mutation => {
              if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && mutation.attributeName === 'class') {
                timeline.pause();
                timeline.clear();

                // Close -> Open
                if (DOMSubNav.classList.contains('w--open')) {
                  // From primary nav
                  if (DOMToggle.parentElement.classList.contains('kat26-navbar-dropdown')) {
                    const columnChildren = [];

                    timeline
                      .fromTo(DOMSubNav, { opacity: 0, display: 'none' }, { opacity: 1, display: 'block', duration: 0.3 })
                      .fromTo(DOMSubNav.querySelector('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-menu-wrapper'), { yPercent: -100 }, { yPercent: 0, duration: 0.3, clearProps: 'all' }, '-=0.3');

                    // Rows to cascade, in DOM order: column children, grid cells that are not columns, callouts, section titles, footers
                    DOMSubNav.querySelectorAll('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-column > *, .kat26-navbar-dropdown-grid > :not(.kat26-navbar-dropdown-column), .kat26-navbar-dropdown-callout, .kat26-navbar-dropdown-section-title, .kat26-navbar-dropdown-footer').forEach(DOMRow => {
                      columnChildren.push(DOMRow);
                    });

                    timeline
                      .fromTo(columnChildren, { opacity: 0, yPercent: -20 }, { opacity: 1, yPercent: 0, duration: 0.2, stagger: 0.05, clearProps: 'all' });
                  } else {
                    timeline
                      .fromTo(DOMSubNav, { opacity: 0, display: 'none' }, { opacity: 1, display: 'block', duration: 0.3 })
                      .fromTo(DOMSubNav.querySelector('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-column').children, { opacity: 0, yPercent: -20 }, { opacity: 1, yPercent: 0, duration: 0.2, stagger: 0.05, clearProps: 'all' });
                  }
                  // Open -> Close
                } else {
                  // From primary nav
                  if (DOMToggle.parentElement.classList.contains('kat26-navbar-dropdown')) {
                    timeline
                      .fromTo(DOMSubNav, { opacity: 1, display: 'block' }, { opacity: 0, display: 'none', duration: 0.3 })
                      .fromTo(DOMSubNav.querySelector('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-menu-wrapper'), { yPercent: 0 }, { yPercent: -100, duration: 0.3, clearProps: 'all' }, '-=0.3');
                  } else {
                    timeline.fromTo(DOMSubNav, { opacity: 1, display: 'block' }, { opacity: 0, display: 'none', duration: 0.3, clearProps: 'all' });

                  }
                }

                timeline.play();
              }
            });
          });

          observer.observe(DOMToggle, { attributes: true });

          hoverHandlers.push({
            DOM: {
              subNav: DOMSubNav
            },
            observer: observer
          });
        });

        return () => {
          hoverHandlers.forEach(hoverHandlerDatum => {
            const DOMSubNavWrapper = hoverHandlerDatum.DOM.subNav.querySelector('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-menu-wrapper');

            hoverHandlerDatum.DOM.subNav.removeAttribute('style');
            hoverHandlerDatum.observer.disconnect();

            if (DOMSubNavWrapper) {
              DOMSubNavWrapper.removeAttribute('style');
            }
          });
        };
      });
    })();
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // END: Menu Interaction
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // BEGIN: Products Menu
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    (function () {
      const productsDOM = {
        wrapper: null,
        nav: {
          wrapper: null,
          navs: [],
          subs: []
        }
      };

      productsDOM.wrapper = menuDOM.wrapper.querySelector('#kat26-menu-item-products');
      productsDOM.wrapper = productsDOM.wrapper ? productsDOM.wrapper.closest('.kat26-navbar-dropdown') : null;

      // No nested (has-menu) submenus in this nav; keep the block inert unless one is added back.
      if (!productsDOM.wrapper || !hasGsap) {
        return;
      }

      productsDOM.nav.wrapper = productsDOM.wrapper.querySelector('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-menu-wrapper');
      productsDOM.nav.navs = productsDOM.wrapper.querySelectorAll('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-item-has-menu .kat26-navbar-dropdown-item');
      productsDOM.nav.subs = productsDOM.wrapper.querySelectorAll('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-submenu');

      const matchMedia = gsap.matchMedia();

      matchMedia.add('(min-width: 992px)', () => {
        const observers = [];
        productsDOM.nav.navs.forEach(DOMSubNav => {
          const observer = new MutationObserver((mutationList) => {
            mutationList.forEach(mutation => {
              if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && mutation.attributeName === 'class') {
                if (DOMSubNav.classList.contains('w--open')) {
                  productsDOM.nav.subs.forEach(DOMSubMenu => {
                    gsap.set(DOMSubMenu, { height: `${Math.ceil(productsDOM.nav.wrapper.getBoundingClientRect().height)}px` });
                  });
                }
              }
            });
          });

          observer.observe(DOMSubNav, { attributes: true });

          observers.push(observer);
        });

        return () => {
          observers.forEach(observer => {
            observer.disconnect();
          });

          productsDOM.nav.subs.forEach(DOMSubMenu => {
            gsap.set(DOMSubMenu, { height: '' });
          });
        }
      });
    })();
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // END: Products Menu
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // BEGIN: Menu Return (mobile "Main menu" link closes the open L2 screen)
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    (function () {
      menuDOM.wrapper.querySelectorAll('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-return').forEach(DOMDropdownReturn => {
        DOMDropdownReturn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          e.preventDefault();

          const DOMDropdown = DOMDropdownReturn.closest('.w-dropdown');
          const DOMToggle = DOMDropdown ? DOMDropdown.querySelector(':scope > .w-dropdown-toggle.w--open') : null;

          tapToggle(DOMToggle);
        });
      });
    })();
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // END: Menu Return
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // BEGIN: Resize Handler
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    (function () {
      const mobileMenuDOM = {
        trigger: document.querySelector('.kat26-navbar-menu-button')
      };

      mobileMenuDOM.trigger.addEventListener('click', function() {
        // Set menu size whenever the mobile hamburger is clicked, this should be a mobile only feature
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          const DOMMenus = menuDOM.wrapper.querySelectorAll('.kat26-navbar-menu');
          const DOMBanner = menuDOM.wrapper.querySelector('.navbar-banner');
          const DOMBar = menuDOM.wrapper.querySelector('.kat26-navbar')

          // Banner is the only element not guaranteed to be rendered
          const newHeight = window.innerHeight - DOMBanner.clientHeight - (DOMBar ? DOMBar.clientHeight : 0);

          DOMMenus.forEach(DOMMenu => {
            DOMMenu.style.height = `${newHeight}px`;
          });
        });
      });

    })();
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // END: Resize Handler
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  const DOMScript = document.currentScript;

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const DOM = {
      triggers: { youtube: [], stream: [] },
      modal: {
        wrapper: DOMScript.closest('.modal-container'),
        content: null,
        close: null
      },
      video: { youtube: null, stream: null }
    };

    const classes = { modal: { active: 'modal-container--active' } };

    function closeModal() {
      if (!DOM.modal.wrapper) return;
      DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.remove(classes.modal.active);

      // Remove iframes to guarantee playback stops (YT + CF Stream)
      if (DOM.video.youtube) DOM.video.youtube.replaceChildren();
      if (DOM.video.stream) DOM.video.stream.replaceChildren();

      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('video-modal-closed'));
    }

    function insertYouTubeIframeAutoplay(videoId) {
      if (!DOM.video.youtube) return;

      // Clear any previous iframe
      DOM.video.youtube.replaceChildren();

      const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
      // Autoplay muted (required by modern autoplay policies), privacy-enhanced host
      const params = new URLSearchParams({
        autoplay: '1',
        mute: '0',
        playsinline: '1',
        rel: '0',
        modestbranding: '1'
        // add extras if you like: controls=1, start=xx, end=yy, cc_load_policy=1, etc.
      });

      iframe.src = `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/${encodeURIComponent(videoId)}?${params.toString()}`;
      iframe.setAttribute('title', 'YouTube video player');
      iframe.setAttribute('frameborder', '0');
      iframe.setAttribute('allow',
        'autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture; accelerometer; gyroscope');
      iframe.allowFullscreen = true;
      iframe.style.cssText = 'border:none;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;';

      DOM.video.youtube.appendChild(iframe);
    }

    function createStreamPlayer(id) {
      if (!DOM.video.stream) return;

      const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
      DOM.video.stream.replaceChildren();
      iframe.src = `https://customer-vonlksqj0yyd6d75.cloudflarestream.com/${id}/iframe`;
      iframe.setAttribute('style', 'border:none;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;height:100%;width:100%;');
      iframe.allow = 'accelerometer; gyroscope; autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture;';
      iframe.allowFullscreen = true;
      DOM.video.stream.append(iframe);
    }

    function openModal(options) {
      DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.add(classes.modal.active);

      if (options.youtube) {
        insertYouTubeIframeAutoplay(options.youtube);
        DOM.video.youtube.classList.add('video-modal-active');
        DOM.video.stream.classList.remove('video-modal-active');
      } else if (options.stream) {
        createStreamPlayer(options.stream);
        DOM.video.youtube.classList.remove('video-modal-active');
        DOM.video.stream.classList.add('video-modal-active');
      }

      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('video-modal-opened'));
    }

    // ---- Early exits / DOM wiring ----
    if (!DOM.modal.wrapper) return;

    DOM.modal.content = DOM.modal.wrapper.querySelector('.modal');
    DOM.modal.close = DOM.modal.wrapper.querySelector('.modal-pricing-item--close-button');
    DOM.video.youtube = DOM.modal.wrapper.querySelector('.modal-fill.youtube');
    DOM.video.stream = DOM.modal.wrapper.querySelector('.modal-fill.stream');
    DOM.triggers.youtube = document.querySelectorAll('[data-youtube-id]');
    DOM.triggers.stream = document.querySelectorAll('[data-stream-id]');

    // ---- Triggers (no YouTube network until click) ----
    DOM.triggers.youtube.forEach(function (el) {
      const id = el.getAttribute('data-youtube-id');
      if (!id) return;
      el.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.contains(classes.modal.active)) return;
        openModal({ youtube: id }); // injects nocookie iframe with autoplay=1&mute=1
      });
    });

    DOM.triggers.stream.forEach(function (el) {
      const id = el.getAttribute('data-stream-id');
      if (!id) return;
      el.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.contains(classes.modal.active)) return;
        openModal({ stream: id });
      });
    });

    // ---- Modal interactions ----
    if (DOM.modal.content) {
      DOM.modal.content.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); });
    }

    if (DOM.modal.close) {
      DOM.modal.close.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        closeModal();
      });
    }

    window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.contains(classes.modal.active) && e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        closeModal();
      }
    });

    // Close when clicking the backdrop (not inside modal content)
    DOM.modal.wrapper.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      if (e.target === DOM.modal.wrapper) {
        e.preventDefault();
        closeModal();
      }
    });

    // Play arbitrary ID
    window.addEventListener('video-modal__play-video', function (e) {
      const modalArgs = {};
      if (e.detail && e.detail.type && (e.detail.type === 'stream' || e.detail.type === 'youtube') && e.detail.id) {
        modalArgs[e.detail.type] = e.detail.id;
        openModal(modalArgs);
      }
    });
  });
})();

<script>
  class SimpleCarousel {
    constructor(options) {
      const _this = this;
      const DOM = {
        carousel: false,
        slides: false,
        dot: {
          container: false,
          template: false,
          all: [],
          classes: {
            active: 'dot--active',
          },
        },
        counter: {
          current: false,
          max: false,
        },
        slider: {
          slides: false,
        },
      };
      const time = {
        tween: false,
        resume: {
          timer: false,
          delay: 6,
        },
        delay: 6,
      };
      const slider = {
        current: 0,
        max: 0,
        stopped: true,
      };

      this.blur = function () {
        const time = _this.time;

        if (time.tween) {
          time.tween.pause();
        }

        if (time.resume.timer) {
          clearTimeout(time.resume.timer);
          time.resume.timer = false;
        }
      };

      this.focus = function () {
        const slider = _this.slider;

        if (!slider.stopped || slider.max <= 1) {
          _this.start();
        }
      };

      this.propagationStop = function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
      };

      this.eventHandlers = []; // For cleanup

      this.classes = {
        active: typeof options.classes !== 'undefined' && typeof options.classes.active === 'string' ? options.classes.active : 'simple-carousel--active',
      };

      this.DOM = DOM;
      this.slider = slider;
      this.time = time;

      this.animate = typeof options.animate === 'boolean' || typeof options.animate === 'object' ? options.animate : true;
      this.auto = typeof options.auto === 'boolean' ? options.auto : true; // Auto progression default to true
      this.scrollFocus = typeof options.scrollFocus === 'boolean' ? options.scrollFocus : false;

      DOM.carousel = options.carousel;
      DOM.slides = [...options.slides];
      DOM.dot.container = typeof options.dot === 'object' && options.dot.container ? options.dot.container : null;
      DOM.dot.template = typeof options.dot === 'object' && options.dot.template ? options.dot.template : null;

      slider.max = DOM.slides.length;
      DOM.dot.container = DOM.dot.container && typeof DOM.dot.container[Symbol.iterator] === 'function' ? [...DOM.dot.container] : DOM.dot.container;

      if (slider.max > 1) {
        let i = 0;
        let DOMNewDot;

        // Hide other slides
        if (_this.animate) {
          gsap.set(DOM.slides.slice(1), { display: 'none', opacity: 0 });
        }

        // Mark first slide as active
        if (DOM.slides[0] instanceof Array) {
          DOM.slides[0].forEach((DOMSlideElement) => {
            DOMSlideElement.classList.add(_this.classes.active);
          });
        } else {
          DOM.slides[0].classList.add(_this.classes.active);
        }

        if (DOM.dot.container) {
          // Multiple dot containers
          if (DOM.dot.container.length) {
            const fills = [];
            // Record each first template dot
            DOM.dot.container.forEach((DOMDotContainer) => {
              if (typeof DOM.dot.all[0] === 'undefined') {
                DOM.dot.all[0] = [];
              }

              // Assumes first child is the templaate
              DOM.dot.all[0].push(DOMDotContainer.children[0]);
              fills.push(DOMDotContainer.children[0].querySelector('.dot__fill'));
            });

            for (i = 1; i < slider.max; i++) {
              DOM.dot.container.forEach((DOMDotContainer, index) => {
                DOMNewDot = DOM.dot.all[0][index].cloneNode(true);
                DOMNewDot.classList.remove(DOM.dot.classes.active);

                DOMDotContainer.append(DOMNewDot);

                if (typeof DOM.dot.all[i] === 'undefined') {
                  DOM.dot.all[i] = [];
                }

                DOM.dot.all[i].push(DOMNewDot);
                fills.push(DOMNewDot.querySelector('.dot__fill'));
              });
            }

            gsap.set(fills, { scaleX: 0 });
            // Single dot container
          } else if (DOM.dot.template) {
            DOM.dot.all.push(DOM.dot.template);

            for (i = 1; i < slider.max; i++) {
              DOMNewDot = DOM.dot.template.cloneNode(true);
              DOMNewDot.classList.remove(DOM.dot.classes.active);

              DOM.dot.container.append(DOMNewDot);
              DOM.dot.all.push(DOMNewDot);
            }

            // Scale down all fills
            gsap.set(DOM.dot.container.querySelectorAll('.dot__fill'), { scaleX: 0 });
          }
        }

        // Assume duplicate handlers are not added
        window.addEventListener('blur', _this.blur);
        _this.eventHandlers.push({ DOM: window, event: 'blur', handler: _this.blur });

        window.addEventListener('focus', this.focus);
        _this.eventHandlers.push({ DOM: window, event: 'focus', handler: _this.focus });
      } else if (DOM.dot.container) {
        // Do not show dots if there is less than one slide
        DOM.dot.container.remove();
      }

      // Add click interaction
      DOM.dot.all.forEach(function (DOMDot, index) {
        const DOMDots = DOMDot;

        function dotClickHandler(e) {
          e.preventDefault();

          _this.pauseTimers(true);

          _this.setCurrent(index);
        }

        // Multiple dot containers
        if (DOMDots instanceof Array) {
          DOMDots.forEach((DOMDot) => {
            DOMDot.addEventListener('click', dotClickHandler);
            _this.eventHandlers.push({ DOM: DOMDot, event: 'click', handler: dotClickHandler });
          });
        } else {
          DOMDot.addEventListener('click', dotClickHandler);
          _this.eventHandlers.push({ DOM: DOMDot, event: 'click', handler: dotClickHandler });
        }
      });

      // If user scrolls off screen, pause automatic progression
      // REQUIRES ScrollTrigger
      if (this.scrollFocus && ScrollTrigger) {
        ScrollTrigger.create({
          trigger: DOM.carousel,
          start: 'top bottom',
          end: 'bottom top',
          onEnter: function () {
            // Start auto progression
            if (_this.auto) {
              _this.start();
            }
          },
          onEnterBack: function () {
            // Start auto progression
            if (_this.auto) {
              _this.start();
            }
          },
          onLeave: function () {
            _this.stop(false);
          },
          onLeaveBack: function () {
            _this.stop(false);
          },
        });

        ScrollTrigger.sort();
        ScrollTrigger.refresh();
      } else {
        // Start auto progression
        if (this.auto) {
          this.start();
        }
      }

      DOM.carousel.addEventListener('click', _this.propagationStop);
      _this.eventHandlers.push({ DOM: DOM.carousel, event: 'click', handler: _this.propagationStop });
    }

    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // METHODS
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

    /**
     * @method pauseTimers
     * @description Pauses progression and other timers
     * @param resume {boolean}
     */
    pauseTimers(resume) {
      const _this = this;
      const DOM = _this.DOM;
      const slider = _this.slider;
      const time = _this.time;

      if (time.tween) {
        time.tween.pause();
      }

      if (DOM.dot.all.length) {
        // Update "current" dot in each dot container
        if (DOM.dot.all[slider.current] instanceof Array) {
          DOM.dot.all[slider.current].forEach((DOMDot) => {
            gsap.set(DOMDot.querySelector('.dot__fill'), { scaleX: 0 });
          });
          // Update "current" dot
        } else {
          gsap.set(DOM.dot.all[slider.current].querySelector('.dot__fill'), { scaleX: 0 });
        }
      }

      if (time.resume.timer) {
        clearTimeout(time.resume.timer);
      }

      // Do not resume if auto progression isn't allowed
      if (_this.auto && resume) {
        this.resumeTimers();
      }
    }

    /**
     * @method resumeTimers
     * @description Starts the resumption timer
     * @returns {undefined}
     */
    resumeTimers() {
      const _this = this;
      const time = _this.time;

      if (!_this.auto) {
        return;
      }

      time.resume.timer = setTimeout(function () {
        _this.start();
        time.resume.timer = false;
      }, time.resume.delay * 1000);
    }

    /**
     * @method prev
     * @description Steps carousel forward one step
     */
    next() {
      const _this = this;

      _this.pauseTimers(true);

      _this.setCurrent(_this.slider.current + 1);
    }

    /**
     * @method prev
     * @description Steps carousel back one step
     */
    prev() {
      const _this = this;

      _this.pauseTimers(true);

      _this.setCurrent(_this.slider.current - 1);
    }

    /**
     * @method setCurrent
     * @param index {number} Slide index to go to
     * @returns {undefined}
     */
    setCurrent(index) {
      const _this = this;
      const DOM = this.DOM;
      const slider = this.slider;
      const timeline = new gsap.timeline({
        onComplete: function () {
          // Trigger potential Webflow animations that occur on scroll
          document.dispatchEvent(new Event('scroll', { bubbles: true }));
        },
      });
      let otherSlides = [];

      index = index < 0 ? DOM.slides.length + index : index;
      index = index >= DOM.slides.length ? index - DOM.slides.length : index;

      // Do not progress if index moves to the current slide
      if (index === slider.current) {
        return;
      }

      if (DOM.dot.container) {
        // Remove active class from dots
        DOM.dot.all.forEach(function (DOMDot) {
          const DOMDots = DOMDot;

          if (DOMDots instanceof Array) {
            DOMDots.forEach((DOMDot) => {
              DOMDot.classList.remove(DOM.dot.classes.active);
            });
          } else {
            DOMDot.classList.remove(DOM.dot.classes.active);
          }
        });

        // Set active dot
        if (DOM.dot.all[index] instanceof Array) {
          const DOMDots = DOM.dot.all[index];

          DOMDots.forEach((DOMDot) => {
            DOMDot.classList.add(DOM.dot.classes.active);
          });
        } else if (DOM.dot.all.length) {
          DOM.dot.all[index].classList.add(DOM.dot.classes.active);
        }
      }

      otherSlides = DOM.slides.filter((DOMSlide, otherIndex) => {
        return otherIndex !== index;
      });

      if (_this.animate) {
        timeline
          .add(() => {
            if (DOM.slides[index] instanceof Array) {
              DOM.slides[index].foreach((DOMSlideElement) => {
                DOMSlideElement.parentElement.append(DOMSlideElement);
              });
            } else {
              DOM.slides[index].parentElement.append(DOM.slides[index]);
            }
          })
          .fromTo(DOM.slides[index], { opacity: 0, display: 'none' }, { opacity: 1, display: 'flex', duration: 0.5 });

        // Assumes slides have no backgrounds
        if (_this.animate.other) {
          otherSlides.forEach((otherSlide) => {
            timeline.to(otherSlide, { opacity: 0, display: 'none', duration: 0.5 }, '-=0.5');
          });
          // Assumes slides have backgrounds
        } else {
          otherSlides.forEach((otherSlide) => {
            timeline.set(otherSlide, { opacity: 0, display: 'none' });
          });
        }
      }

      // Mark other slides as inactive
      DOM.slides.forEach((DOMSlide) => {
        if (DOMSlide instanceof Array) {
          DOMSlide.forEach((DOMSlideElement) => {
            DOMSlideElement.classList.remove(_this.classes.active);
            DOMSlideElement.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('simple-carousel__slide-inactive'));
          });
        } else {
          DOMSlide.classList.remove(_this.classes.active);
          DOMSlide.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('simple-carousel__slide-inactive'));
        }
      });

      // Mark current slide as active
      if (DOM.slides[index] instanceof Array) {
        DOM.slides[index].forEach((DOMSlideElement) => {
          DOMSlideElement.classList.add(_this.classes.active);
          DOMSlideElement.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('simple-carousel__slide-active'));
        });
      } else {
        DOM.slides[index].classList.add(_this.classes.active);
        DOM.slides[index].dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('simple-carousel__slide-active'));
      }

      slider.current = index;
    }

    /**
     * @method start
     * @description Starts auto progression
     */
    start() {
      const _this = this;
      const DOM = this.DOM;
      const time = this.time;
      const slider = this.slider;
      const _DOM = {
        currentSlide: DOM.slides[slider.current],
        fills: [],
      };
      let duration = _DOM.currentSlide instanceof Array ? time.delay : _DOM.currentSlide.getAttribute('data-delay');

      slider.stopped = false;

(function () {

      close: false,
      search: {
        form: false,
        input: false,
        trigger: false,
        clear: false,

      return;

    DOM.close = DOM.wrapper.querySelector('.search__close');

    DOM.search.form = DOM.wrapper.querySelector('form');
    DOM.search.input = DOM.wrapper.querySelector('input');
    DOM.search.trigger = DOM.wrapper.querySelector('.search__trigger');
    DOM.search.clear = DOM.wrapper.querySelector('.search__clear');

    DOM.search.trigger.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
    
      DOM.search.form.submit();
    });

    DOM.search.clear.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
    
      DOM.search.input.value = '';
      DOM.search.input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
    });

    DOM.trigger.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();

      DOM.wrapper.classList.add('kat26-navbar-modal-container--active');
      DOM.search.input.focus();
    });

    DOM.close.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      DOM.wrapper.classList.remove('kat26-navbar-modal-container--active');
    });

    window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (DOM.wrapper.classList.contains('kat26-navbar-modal-container--active') && e.key === 'Escape') {

        DOM.wrapper.classList.remove('kat26-navbar-modal-container--active');

<script>
(function () {
  const DOMScript = document.currentScript;

  function init() {
    const menuDOM = {
      wrapper: (DOMScript && DOMScript.closest('.kat26-navbar-container')) || document.querySelector('.kat26-navbar-container')
    };

    if (!menuDOM.wrapper) {
      return;
    }

    const hasGsap = typeof gsap !== 'undefined';
    const desktopQuery = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 992px)');

    // Toggle a Webflow dropdown the way Webflow expects. Its dropdown module listens on the toggle for a native
    // 'mouseup' (mouse devices) or 'click' (touch devices); jQuery's 'tap' is only an alias for click, so a
    // trigger('tap') never opens a dropdown on desktop.
    function tapToggle(DOMToggle) {
      if (!DOMToggle) {
        return;
      }

      // Webflow binds the toggle to 'mouseup' on mouse devices and to 'click' on touch devices, so send both.
      DOMToggle.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0, buttons: 1 }));
      DOMToggle.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0 }));
      DOMToggle.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0 }));
    }

    function closeOpenDropdowns(except) {
      menuDOM.wrapper.querySelectorAll('.kat26-navbar-dropdown').forEach(DOMDropdown => {
        if (DOMDropdown === except) {
          return;
        }

        tapToggle(DOMDropdown.querySelector(':scope > .w-dropdown-toggle.w--open'));
      });
    }

    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // BEGIN: Hover control (native dropdown hover suppressed; desktop hover with grace, mobile tap-only)
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    (function () {
      const GRACE_MS = 180; // Used to prevent "instant" menu opens
      let timer = null; // This is a global timer

      // Verify if there's a current open nav
      function hasOpenNav() {
        return menuDOM.wrapper.querySelectorAll('.w--open').length !== 0;
      }

      menuDOM.wrapper.querySelectorAll('.kat26-navbar-dropdown').forEach(DOMDropdown => {
        const DOMToggle = DOMDropdown.querySelector(':scope > .w-dropdown-toggle');

        if (!DOMToggle) {
          return;
        }

        function setOpen() {
          if (!DOMToggle.classList.contains('w--open')) {
            closeOpenDropdowns(DOMDropdown);
            tapToggle(DOMToggle);
          }
        }

        // Webflow binds its own hover open/close through jQuery mouseenter/mouseleave, which jQuery
        // implements on mouseover/mouseout. Stop those at the wrapper (capture phase) so the native
        // hover never fires: below 992px the drawer becomes tap-only, above it the handlers below take over
        // with a grace period. Native mouseenter/mouseleave used here are unaffected.
        ['mouseover', 'mouseout'].forEach(type => {
          DOMDropdown.addEventListener(type, function (e) {
            e.stopImmediatePropagation();
          }, true);
        });

        DOMDropdown.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () {
          if (!desktopQuery.matches) {
            return;
          }

          clearTimeout(timer);

          // Do not wait, open immediately
          if (hasOpenNav()) {
            setOpen();
            // Wait for a few MS to avoid unintended menu opens
          } else {
            timer = setTimeout(() => {
              setOpen();
            }, GRACE_MS);
          }
        });

        DOMDropdown.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
          if (!desktopQuery.matches) {
            return;
          }

          clearTimeout(timer);

          if (DOMToggle.classList.contains('w--open')) {
            tapToggle(DOMToggle);
          }

        });
      });
    })();
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // END: Hover control
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // BEGIN: Menu Interaction
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    (function () {
      if (!hasGsap) {
        return;
      }

      const buttonDOM = {
        nav: {
          toggles: menuDOM.wrapper.querySelectorAll('.w-dropdown-toggle')
        }
      };
      const matchMedia = gsap.matchMedia();

      matchMedia.add('(min-width: 992px)', () => {
        const hoverHandlers = [];

        buttonDOM.nav.toggles.forEach(DOMToggle => {
          const DOMSubNav = DOMToggle.parentElement.querySelector('.w-dropdown-list');
          const timeline = gsap.timeline();
          const observer = new MutationObserver((mutationList) => {
            mutationList.forEach(mutation => {
              if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && mutation.attributeName === 'class') {
                timeline.pause();
                timeline.clear();

                // Close -> Open
                if (DOMSubNav.classList.contains('w--open')) {
                  // From primary nav
                  if (DOMToggle.parentElement.classList.contains('kat26-navbar-dropdown')) {
                    const columnChildren = [];

                    timeline
                      .fromTo(DOMSubNav, { opacity: 0, display: 'none' }, { opacity: 1, display: 'block', duration: 0.3 })
                      .fromTo(DOMSubNav.querySelector('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-menu-wrapper'), { yPercent: -100 }, { yPercent: 0, duration: 0.3, clearProps: 'all' }, '-=0.3');

                    // Rows to cascade, in DOM order: column children, grid cells that are not columns, callouts, section titles, footers
                    DOMSubNav.querySelectorAll('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-column > *, .kat26-navbar-dropdown-grid > :not(.kat26-navbar-dropdown-column), .kat26-navbar-dropdown-callout, .kat26-navbar-dropdown-section-title, .kat26-navbar-dropdown-footer').forEach(DOMRow => {
                      columnChildren.push(DOMRow);
                    });

                    timeline
                      .fromTo(columnChildren, { opacity: 0, yPercent: -20 }, { opacity: 1, yPercent: 0, duration: 0.2, stagger: 0.05, clearProps: 'all' });
                  } else {
                    timeline
                      .fromTo(DOMSubNav, { opacity: 0, display: 'none' }, { opacity: 1, display: 'block', duration: 0.3 })
                      .fromTo(DOMSubNav.querySelector('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-column').children, { opacity: 0, yPercent: -20 }, { opacity: 1, yPercent: 0, duration: 0.2, stagger: 0.05, clearProps: 'all' });
                  }
                  // Open -> Close
                } else {
                  // From primary nav
                  if (DOMToggle.parentElement.classList.contains('kat26-navbar-dropdown')) {
                    timeline
                      .fromTo(DOMSubNav, { opacity: 1, display: 'block' }, { opacity: 0, display: 'none', duration: 0.3 })
                      .fromTo(DOMSubNav.querySelector('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-menu-wrapper'), { yPercent: 0 }, { yPercent: -100, duration: 0.3, clearProps: 'all' }, '-=0.3');
                  } else {
                    timeline.fromTo(DOMSubNav, { opacity: 1, display: 'block' }, { opacity: 0, display: 'none', duration: 0.3, clearProps: 'all' });

                  }
                }

                timeline.play();
              }
            });
          });

          observer.observe(DOMToggle, { attributes: true });

          hoverHandlers.push({
            DOM: {
              subNav: DOMSubNav
            },
            observer: observer
          });
        });

        return () => {
          hoverHandlers.forEach(hoverHandlerDatum => {
            const DOMSubNavWrapper = hoverHandlerDatum.DOM.subNav.querySelector('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-menu-wrapper');

            hoverHandlerDatum.DOM.subNav.removeAttribute('style');
            hoverHandlerDatum.observer.disconnect();

            if (DOMSubNavWrapper) {
              DOMSubNavWrapper.removeAttribute('style');
            }
          });
        };
      });
    })();
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // END: Menu Interaction
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // BEGIN: Products Menu
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    (function () {
      const productsDOM = {
        wrapper: null,
        nav: {
          wrapper: null,
          navs: [],
          subs: []
        }
      };

      productsDOM.wrapper = menuDOM.wrapper.querySelector('#kat26-menu-item-products');
      productsDOM.wrapper = productsDOM.wrapper ? productsDOM.wrapper.closest('.kat26-navbar-dropdown') : null;

      // No nested (has-menu) submenus in this nav; keep the block inert unless one is added back.
      if (!productsDOM.wrapper || !hasGsap) {
        return;
      }

      productsDOM.nav.wrapper = productsDOM.wrapper.querySelector('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-menu-wrapper');
      productsDOM.nav.navs = productsDOM.wrapper.querySelectorAll('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-item-has-menu .kat26-navbar-dropdown-item');
      productsDOM.nav.subs = productsDOM.wrapper.querySelectorAll('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-submenu');

      const matchMedia = gsap.matchMedia();

      matchMedia.add('(min-width: 992px)', () => {
        const observers = [];
        productsDOM.nav.navs.forEach(DOMSubNav => {
          const observer = new MutationObserver((mutationList) => {
            mutationList.forEach(mutation => {
              if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && mutation.attributeName === 'class') {
                if (DOMSubNav.classList.contains('w--open')) {
                  productsDOM.nav.subs.forEach(DOMSubMenu => {
                    gsap.set(DOMSubMenu, { height: `${Math.ceil(productsDOM.nav.wrapper.getBoundingClientRect().height)}px` });
                  });
                }
              }
            });
          });

          observer.observe(DOMSubNav, { attributes: true });

          observers.push(observer);
        });

        return () => {
          observers.forEach(observer => {
            observer.disconnect();
          });

          productsDOM.nav.subs.forEach(DOMSubMenu => {
            gsap.set(DOMSubMenu, { height: '' });
          });
        }
      });
    })();
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // END: Products Menu
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // BEGIN: Menu Return (mobile "Main menu" link closes the open L2 screen)
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    (function () {
      menuDOM.wrapper.querySelectorAll('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-return').forEach(DOMDropdownReturn => {
        DOMDropdownReturn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          e.preventDefault();

          const DOMDropdown = DOMDropdownReturn.closest('.w-dropdown');
          const DOMToggle = DOMDropdown ? DOMDropdown.querySelector(':scope > .w-dropdown-toggle.w--open') : null;

          tapToggle(DOMToggle);
        });
      });
    })();
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // END: Menu Return
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // BEGIN: Resize Handler
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    (function () {
      const mobileMenuDOM = {
        trigger: document.querySelector('.kat26-navbar-menu-button')
      };

      mobileMenuDOM.trigger.addEventListener('click', function() {
        // Set menu size whenever the mobile hamburger is clicked, this should be a mobile only feature
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          const DOMMenus = menuDOM.wrapper.querySelectorAll('.kat26-navbar-menu');
          const DOMBanner = menuDOM.wrapper.querySelector('.navbar-banner');
          const DOMBar = menuDOM.wrapper.querySelector('.kat26-navbar')

          // Banner is the only element not guaranteed to be rendered
          const newHeight = window.innerHeight - DOMBanner.clientHeight - (DOMBar ? DOMBar.clientHeight : 0);

          DOMMenus.forEach(DOMMenu => {
            DOMMenu.style.height = `${newHeight}px`;
          });
        });
      });

    })();
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // END: Resize Handler
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  const DOMScript = document.currentScript;

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const DOM = {
      triggers: { youtube: [], stream: [] },
      modal: {
        wrapper: DOMScript.closest('.modal-container'),
        content: null,
        close: null
      },
      video: { youtube: null, stream: null }
    };

    const classes = { modal: { active: 'modal-container--active' } };

    function closeModal() {
      if (!DOM.modal.wrapper) return;
      DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.remove(classes.modal.active);

      // Remove iframes to guarantee playback stops (YT + CF Stream)
      if (DOM.video.youtube) DOM.video.youtube.replaceChildren();
      if (DOM.video.stream) DOM.video.stream.replaceChildren();

      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('video-modal-closed'));
    }

    function insertYouTubeIframeAutoplay(videoId) {
      if (!DOM.video.youtube) return;

      // Clear any previous iframe
      DOM.video.youtube.replaceChildren();

      const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
      // Autoplay muted (required by modern autoplay policies), privacy-enhanced host
      const params = new URLSearchParams({
        autoplay: '1',
        mute: '0',
        playsinline: '1',
        rel: '0',
        modestbranding: '1'
        // add extras if you like: controls=1, start=xx, end=yy, cc_load_policy=1, etc.
      });

      iframe.src = `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/${encodeURIComponent(videoId)}?${params.toString()}`;
      iframe.setAttribute('title', 'YouTube video player');
      iframe.setAttribute('frameborder', '0');
      iframe.setAttribute('allow',
        'autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture; accelerometer; gyroscope');
      iframe.allowFullscreen = true;
      iframe.style.cssText = 'border:none;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;';

      DOM.video.youtube.appendChild(iframe);
    }

    function createStreamPlayer(id) {
      if (!DOM.video.stream) return;

      const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
      DOM.video.stream.replaceChildren();
      iframe.src = `https://customer-vonlksqj0yyd6d75.cloudflarestream.com/${id}/iframe`;
      iframe.setAttribute('style', 'border:none;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;height:100%;width:100%;');
      iframe.allow = 'accelerometer; gyroscope; autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture;';
      iframe.allowFullscreen = true;
      DOM.video.stream.append(iframe);
    }

    function openModal(options) {
      DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.add(classes.modal.active);

      if (options.youtube) {
        insertYouTubeIframeAutoplay(options.youtube);
        DOM.video.youtube.classList.add('video-modal-active');
        DOM.video.stream.classList.remove('video-modal-active');
      } else if (options.stream) {
        createStreamPlayer(options.stream);
        DOM.video.youtube.classList.remove('video-modal-active');
        DOM.video.stream.classList.add('video-modal-active');
      }

      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('video-modal-opened'));
    }

    // ---- Early exits / DOM wiring ----
    if (!DOM.modal.wrapper) return;

    DOM.modal.content = DOM.modal.wrapper.querySelector('.modal');
    DOM.modal.close = DOM.modal.wrapper.querySelector('.modal-pricing-item--close-button');
    DOM.video.youtube = DOM.modal.wrapper.querySelector('.modal-fill.youtube');
    DOM.video.stream = DOM.modal.wrapper.querySelector('.modal-fill.stream');
    DOM.triggers.youtube = document.querySelectorAll('[data-youtube-id]');
    DOM.triggers.stream = document.querySelectorAll('[data-stream-id]');

    // ---- Triggers (no YouTube network until click) ----
    DOM.triggers.youtube.forEach(function (el) {
      const id = el.getAttribute('data-youtube-id');
      if (!id) return;
      el.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.contains(classes.modal.active)) return;
        openModal({ youtube: id }); // injects nocookie iframe with autoplay=1&mute=1
      });
    });

    DOM.triggers.stream.forEach(function (el) {
      const id = el.getAttribute('data-stream-id');
      if (!id) return;
      el.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.contains(classes.modal.active)) return;
        openModal({ stream: id });
      });
    });

    // ---- Modal interactions ----
    if (DOM.modal.content) {
      DOM.modal.content.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); });
    }

    if (DOM.modal.close) {
      DOM.modal.close.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        closeModal();
      });
    }

    window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.contains(classes.modal.active) && e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        closeModal();
      }
    });

    // Close when clicking the backdrop (not inside modal content)
    DOM.modal.wrapper.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      if (e.target === DOM.modal.wrapper) {
        e.preventDefault();
        closeModal();
      }
    });

    // Play arbitrary ID
    window.addEventListener('video-modal__play-video', function (e) {
      const modalArgs = {};
      if (e.detail && e.detail.type && (e.detail.type === 'stream' || e.detail.type === 'youtube') && e.detail.id) {
        modalArgs[e.detail.type] = e.detail.id;
        openModal(modalArgs);
      }
    });
  });
})();

<script>
  class SimpleCarousel {
    constructor(options) {
      const _this = this;
      const DOM = {
        carousel: false,
        slides: false,
        dot: {
          container: false,
          template: false,
          all: [],
          classes: {
            active: 'dot--active',
          },
        },
        counter: {
          current: false,
          max: false,
        },
        slider: {
          slides: false,
        },
      };
      const time = {
        tween: false,
        resume: {
          timer: false,
          delay: 6,
        },
        delay: 6,
      };
      const slider = {
        current: 0,
        max: 0,
        stopped: true,
      };

      this.blur = function () {
        const time = _this.time;

        if (time.tween) {
          time.tween.pause();
        }

        if (time.resume.timer) {
          clearTimeout(time.resume.timer);
          time.resume.timer = false;
        }
      };

      this.focus = function () {
        const slider = _this.slider;

        if (!slider.stopped || slider.max <= 1) {
          _this.start();
        }
      };

      this.propagationStop = function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
      };

      this.eventHandlers = []; // For cleanup

      this.classes = {
        active: typeof options.classes !== 'undefined' && typeof options.classes.active === 'string' ? options.classes.active : 'simple-carousel--active',
      };

      this.DOM = DOM;
      this.slider = slider;
      this.time = time;

      this.animate = typeof options.animate === 'boolean' || typeof options.animate === 'object' ? options.animate : true;
      this.auto = typeof options.auto === 'boolean' ? options.auto : true; // Auto progression default to true
      this.scrollFocus = typeof options.scrollFocus === 'boolean' ? options.scrollFocus : false;

      DOM.carousel = options.carousel;
      DOM.slides = [...options.slides];
      DOM.dot.container = typeof options.dot === 'object' && options.dot.container ? options.dot.container : null;
      DOM.dot.template = typeof options.dot === 'object' && options.dot.template ? options.dot.template : null;

      slider.max = DOM.slides.length;
      DOM.dot.container = DOM.dot.container && typeof DOM.dot.container[Symbol.iterator] === 'function' ? [...DOM.dot.container] : DOM.dot.container;

      if (slider.max > 1) {
        let i = 0;
        let DOMNewDot;

        // Hide other slides
        if (_this.animate) {
          gsap.set(DOM.slides.slice(1), { display: 'none', opacity: 0 });
        }

        // Mark first slide as active
        if (DOM.slides[0] instanceof Array) {
          DOM.slides[0].forEach((DOMSlideElement) => {
            DOMSlideElement.classList.add(_this.classes.active);
          });
        } else {
          DOM.slides[0].classList.add(_this.classes.active);
        }

        if (DOM.dot.container) {
          // Multiple dot containers
          if (DOM.dot.container.length) {
            const fills = [];
            // Record each first template dot
            DOM.dot.container.forEach((DOMDotContainer) => {
              if (typeof DOM.dot.all[0] === 'undefined') {
                DOM.dot.all[0] = [];
              }

              // Assumes first child is the templaate
              DOM.dot.all[0].push(DOMDotContainer.children[0]);
              fills.push(DOMDotContainer.children[0].querySelector('.dot__fill'));
            });

            for (i = 1; i < slider.max; i++) {
              DOM.dot.container.forEach((DOMDotContainer, index) => {
                DOMNewDot = DOM.dot.all[0][index].cloneNode(true);
                DOMNewDot.classList.remove(DOM.dot.classes.active);

                DOMDotContainer.append(DOMNewDot);

                if (typeof DOM.dot.all[i] === 'undefined') {
                  DOM.dot.all[i] = [];
                }

                DOM.dot.all[i].push(DOMNewDot);
                fills.push(DOMNewDot.querySelector('.dot__fill'));
              });
            }

            gsap.set(fills, { scaleX: 0 });
            // Single dot container
          } else if (DOM.dot.template) {
            DOM.dot.all.push(DOM.dot.template);

            for (i = 1; i < slider.max; i++) {
              DOMNewDot = DOM.dot.template.cloneNode(true);
              DOMNewDot.classList.remove(DOM.dot.classes.active);

              DOM.dot.container.append(DOMNewDot);
              DOM.dot.all.push(DOMNewDot);
            }

            // Scale down all fills
            gsap.set(DOM.dot.container.querySelectorAll('.dot__fill'), { scaleX: 0 });
          }
        }

        // Assume duplicate handlers are not added
        window.addEventListener('blur', _this.blur);
        _this.eventHandlers.push({ DOM: window, event: 'blur', handler: _this.blur });

        window.addEventListener('focus', this.focus);
        _this.eventHandlers.push({ DOM: window, event: 'focus', handler: _this.focus });
      } else if (DOM.dot.container) {
        // Do not show dots if there is less than one slide
        DOM.dot.container.remove();
      }

      // Add click interaction
      DOM.dot.all.forEach(function (DOMDot, index) {
        const DOMDots = DOMDot;

        function dotClickHandler(e) {
          e.preventDefault();

          _this.pauseTimers(true);

          _this.setCurrent(index);
        }

        // Multiple dot containers
        if (DOMDots instanceof Array) {
          DOMDots.forEach((DOMDot) => {
            DOMDot.addEventListener('click', dotClickHandler);
            _this.eventHandlers.push({ DOM: DOMDot, event: 'click', handler: dotClickHandler });
          });
        } else {
          DOMDot.addEventListener('click', dotClickHandler);
          _this.eventHandlers.push({ DOM: DOMDot, event: 'click', handler: dotClickHandler });
        }
      });

      // If user scrolls off screen, pause automatic progression
      // REQUIRES ScrollTrigger
      if (this.scrollFocus && ScrollTrigger) {
        ScrollTrigger.create({
          trigger: DOM.carousel,
          start: 'top bottom',
          end: 'bottom top',
          onEnter: function () {
            // Start auto progression
            if (_this.auto) {
              _this.start();
            }
          },
          onEnterBack: function () {
            // Start auto progression
            if (_this.auto) {
              _this.start();
            }
          },
          onLeave: function () {
            _this.stop(false);
          },
          onLeaveBack: function () {
            _this.stop(false);
          },
        });

        ScrollTrigger.sort();
        ScrollTrigger.refresh();
      } else {
        // Start auto progression
        if (this.auto) {
          this.start();
        }
      }

      DOM.carousel.addEventListener('click', _this.propagationStop);
      _this.eventHandlers.push({ DOM: DOM.carousel, event: 'click', handler: _this.propagationStop });
    }

    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // METHODS
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

    /**
     * @method pauseTimers
     * @description Pauses progression and other timers
     * @param resume {boolean}
     */
    pauseTimers(resume) {
      const _this = this;
      const DOM = _this.DOM;
      const slider = _this.slider;
      const time = _this.time;

      if (time.tween) {
        time.tween.pause();
      }

      if (DOM.dot.all.length) {
        // Update "current" dot in each dot container
        if (DOM.dot.all[slider.current] instanceof Array) {
          DOM.dot.all[slider.current].forEach((DOMDot) => {
            gsap.set(DOMDot.querySelector('.dot__fill'), { scaleX: 0 });
          });
          // Update "current" dot
        } else {
          gsap.set(DOM.dot.all[slider.current].querySelector('.dot__fill'), { scaleX: 0 });
        }
      }

      if (time.resume.timer) {
        clearTimeout(time.resume.timer);
      }

      // Do not resume if auto progression isn't allowed
      if (_this.auto && resume) {
        this.resumeTimers();
      }
    }

    /**
     * @method resumeTimers
     * @description Starts the resumption timer
     * @returns {undefined}
     */
    resumeTimers() {
      const _this = this;
      const time = _this.time;

      if (!_this.auto) {
        return;
      }

      time.resume.timer = setTimeout(function () {
        _this.start();
        time.resume.timer = false;
      }, time.resume.delay * 1000);
    }

    /**
     * @method prev
     * @description Steps carousel forward one step
     */
    next() {
      const _this = this;

      _this.pauseTimers(true);

      _this.setCurrent(_this.slider.current + 1);
    }

    /**
     * @method prev
     * @description Steps carousel back one step
     */
    prev() {
      const _this = this;

      _this.pauseTimers(true);

      _this.setCurrent(_this.slider.current - 1);
    }

    /**
     * @method setCurrent
     * @param index {number} Slide index to go to
     * @returns {undefined}
     */
    setCurrent(index) {
      const _this = this;
      const DOM = this.DOM;
      const slider = this.slider;
      const timeline = new gsap.timeline({
        onComplete: function () {
          // Trigger potential Webflow animations that occur on scroll
          document.dispatchEvent(new Event('scroll', { bubbles: true }));
        },
      });
      let otherSlides = [];

      index = index < 0 ? DOM.slides.length + index : index;
      index = index >= DOM.slides.length ? index - DOM.slides.length : index;

      // Do not progress if index moves to the current slide
      if (index === slider.current) {
        return;
      }

      if (DOM.dot.container) {
        // Remove active class from dots
        DOM.dot.all.forEach(function (DOMDot) {
          const DOMDots = DOMDot;

          if (DOMDots instanceof Array) {
            DOMDots.forEach((DOMDot) => {
              DOMDot.classList.remove(DOM.dot.classes.active);
            });
          } else {
            DOMDot.classList.remove(DOM.dot.classes.active);
          }
        });

        // Set active dot

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    // BEGIN: Hero
    (function () {
      const homeDOM = {
        wrapper: document.querySelector('#hero-wrapper'),
        video: null,
      };

      if (!homeDOM.wrapper) {
        return;
      }

      homeDOM.video = document.querySelector('#hero-intro-video');

      let scrollY = 0;
      let locked = false;

      function preventDefault(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
      }

      function preventKeys(e) {
        const keys = [' ', 'PageUp', 'PageDown', 'End', 'Home', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown'];
        if (keys.includes(e.key)) e.preventDefault();
      }

      function lockScroll() {
        if (locked) return;
        locked = true;
        scrollY = window.scrollY;
        window.scrollTo(0, 0);
        document.documentElement.classList.add('hero-scroll-lock');
        window.addEventListener('wheel', preventDefault, { passive: false });
        window.addEventListener('touchmove', preventDefault, { passive: false });
        window.addEventListener('keydown', preventKeys);
      }

      function unlockScroll() {
        if (!locked) return;
        locked = false;
        document.documentElement.classList.remove('hero-scroll-lock');
        window.removeEventListener('wheel', preventDefault);
        window.removeEventListener('touchmove', preventDefault);
        window.removeEventListener('keydown', preventKeys);
        window.scrollTo(0, scrollY);
      }

      homeDOM.video.addEventListener('generic-video__playing', function () {
        lockScroll();
        gsap.to(homeDOM.video.querySelector('video'), { opacity: 1, duration: 1 });

          .set(homeDOM.wrapper, { display: 'none' })
          .call(unlockScroll);
      });

      // Safety net: if the video stops/errors before the wipe, release the page.
      homeDOM.video.addEventListener('generic-video__stopped', unlockScroll);
    })();

y1="11.3321" y2="0.707107" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"></line></svg><div class="script w-embed w-script"><script>
  (function () {
    const DOMScript = document.currentScript;

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
      // ---------- CONFIG ----------
      const BANNER_MIN_HEIGHT = 35; // px
      const BANNER_PADDING = 12; // px

      // ---------- DOM ----------
      const DOM = {
        banner: DOMScript.closest('.navbar-banner'),
        container: null,
        content: null,
        copy: null,
        close: null,
        body: null,
      };

      if (!DOM.banner) return;

      DOM.container = DOM.banner.querySelector('.navbar-banner-wrapper');
      DOM.content = DOM.banner.querySelector('.w-dyn-list');
      DOM.close = DOM.banner.querySelector('.navbar-banner-close');
      DOM.body = document.querySelector('body');

      // Default hidden
      if (DOM.banner) gsap.set(DOM.banner, { paddingTop: 0, paddingBottom: 0, height: 0 });

      // ---------- Cookie utils (JSON array in cookie) ----------
      function getCookie(name) {
        const m = document.cookie.match(new RegExp('(?:^|; )' + name.replace(/([.$?*|{}()[\]\\/+^])/g, '\\$1') + '=([^;]*)'));
        return m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : null;
      }
      function setCookie(name, value, days) {
        const expires = (() => {
          if (!days) return '';
          const d = new Date();
          d.setTime(d.getTime() + days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
          return '; expires=' + d.toUTCString();
        })();
        document.cookie = name + '=' + encodeURIComponent(value) + expires + '; path=/; domain=' + location.hostname;
      }
      function getCookieJSON(name, fallback) {
        try {
          const raw = getCookie(name);
          return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : fallback;
        } catch (e) {
          return fallback;
        }
      }
      function setCookieJSON(name, obj, days) {
        try {
          let raw = JSON.stringify(obj);
          // keep under common 4KB cookie limit
          while (raw.length > 3500 && Array.isArray(obj) && obj.length > 1) {
            obj.shift();
            raw = JSON.stringify(obj);
          }
          setCookie(name, raw, days);
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      const DISMISSED_COOKIE = 'coreweave_banners';
      let dismissedIds = getCookieJSON(DISMISSED_COOKIE, []);
      let currentBannerId = null;

      // ---------- Helpers ----------
      function parseList(attr) {
        if (!attr) return [];
        return attr
          .split(/[\s,]+/)
          .map((s) => s.trim())
          .filter(Boolean);
      }
      function toUTCDate(str) {
        if (!str) return null;
        const iso = /T|Z/.test(str) ? str : str.replace(' ', 'T') + 'Z';
        const d = new Date(iso);
        return isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
      }
      function normalizePath(p) {
        if (!p) return '/';
        return p.length > 1 ? p.replace(/\/+$/, '') : p;
      }
      function makeMatcher(patterns) {
        const regs = patterns.map((pat) => {
          const esc = normalizePath(pat)
            .replace(/[.+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')
            .replace(/\\\*/g, '.*');
          return new RegExp('^' + esc + '(?:/)?$');
        });
        return (path) => regs.some((r) => r.test(normalizePath(path)));
      }

      // ---------- Eligibility (includes per-ID dismissal) ----------
      function selectEligibleItem(items) {
        const now = new Date(); // compared against UTC-parsed dates
        const path = normalizePath(location.pathname);

        for (const item of items) {
          return item;
          const ds = item.dataset;
          const bannerId = (ds.bannerId || '').trim();
          if (bannerId && dismissedIds.includes(bannerId)) continue; // already dismissed

          const startAt = toUTCDate(ds.startAt);
          const endAt = toUTCDate(ds.endAt);
          if (startAt && now < startAt) continue;
          if (endAt && now > endAt) continue;

          const hideList = parseList(ds.hidePaths);
          const showList = parseList(ds.showPaths);

          const matchesHide = hideList.length ? makeMatcher(hideList)(path) : false;
          if (matchesHide) continue; // hide overrides

          if (showList.length) {
            const matchesShow = makeMatcher(showList)(path);
            if (!matchesShow) continue;
          }

          currentBannerId = bannerId || null;
          return item; // first eligible in DOM order
        }
        return null;
      }

      // ---------- GSAP show/hide (fixed height) ----------
      function showBanner() {
        const h = BANNER_MIN_HEIGHT;
        const tl = gsap.timeline();
        const contentBounds = DOM.content.getBoundingClientRect();
        const targetHeight = Math.max(contentBounds.height, BANNER_MIN_HEIGHT); // Math.max(contentBounds.height + BANNER_PADDING, BANNER_MIN_HEIGHT);

        tl.to(DOM.banner, { height: targetHeight, paddingTop: BANNER_PADDING, paddingBottom: BANNER_PADDING, duration: 0.5, clearProps: 'all' }).to(DOM.body, { paddingTop: targetHeight * 0.95, duration: 0.5 }, '-=0.5');

        DOM.banner.classList.add('active');
      }

      function hideBanner() {
        const tl = gsap.timeline();
        const contentBounds = DOM.content.getBoundingClientRect();
        const targetHeight = Math.max(contentBounds.height, BANNER_MIN_HEIGHT);

        // Record dismissal
        if (currentBannerId) {
          if (!dismissedIds.includes(currentBannerId)) {
            dismissedIds.push(currentBannerId);
            setCookieJSON(DISMISSED_COOKIE, dismissedIds, 30); // 30 days
          }
        }

        tl.to(DOM.banner, { height: 0, paddingTop: 0, paddingBottom: 0, display: 'none', duration: 0.5 }).to(DOM.body, { paddingTop: 0, duration: 0.5 }, '-=0.5');

        DOM.banner.classList.remove('active');
      }

      function offsetContent() {
        if (!DOM.banner.classList.contains('active')) return;
        const h = BANNER_MIN_HEIGHT;
        const contentBounds = DOM.content.getBoundingClientRect();
        const targetHeight = Math.max(contentBounds.height, BANNER_MIN_HEIGHT);
        gsap.set(DOM.body, { paddingTop: targetHeight * 0.95 });
      }

      // ---------- Legacy cookie handling ----------
      // We previously used a global 'coreweave_banner' closed flag and want to keep honoring it:
      const legacyClosed = (function () {
        const m = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|; )coreweave_banner=([^;]*)/);
        return !!(m && m[1]);
      })();
      if (legacyClosed && dismissedIds.length === 0) {
        // Comment out this return to ignore the legacy cookie.
        return;
      }

      // ---------- Run ----------
      const items = Array.from(DOM.banner.querySelectorAll('[role="listitem"], .w-dyn-item'));
      const chosen = selectEligibleItem(items);
      if (!chosen) return;

      // Keep only chosen item for accurate height and clean DOM
      items.forEach((it) => {
        if (it !== chosen) it.remove();
      });

      DOM.copy = chosen.querySelector('.navbar-banner-content');
      if (!DOM.copy) return;

      window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        showBanner();
      });

      // Close interactions
      if (DOM.close) {
        DOM.close.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          hideBanner();
        });
      }
      if (DOM.container) {
        DOM.container.querySelectorAll('a:not(.navbar-banner-close)').forEach(function (DOMLink) {
          DOMLink.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
          });
        });
      }

      // Responsive recalculation
      window.addEventListener(
        'resize',
        (function () {
          let timer = null;
          return function () {
            if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
            timer = setTimeout(function () {
              offsetContent();
              timer = null;
            }, 300);
          };
        })(),
      );
    });
  })();
