<script>
(function () {
  const DOMScript = document.currentScript;

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const DOM = {
      triggers: { youtube: [], stream: [] },
      modal: {
        wrapper: DOMScript.closest('.modal-container'),
        content: null,
        close: null
      },
      video: { youtube: null, stream: null }
    };

    const classes = { modal: { active: 'modal-container--active' } };

    function closeModal() {
      if (!DOM.modal.wrapper) return;
      DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.remove(classes.modal.active);

      // Remove iframes to guarantee playback stops (YT + CF Stream)
      if (DOM.video.youtube) DOM.video.youtube.replaceChildren();
      if (DOM.video.stream) DOM.video.stream.replaceChildren();

      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('video-modal-closed'));
    }

    function insertYouTubeIframeAutoplay(videoId) {
      if (!DOM.video.youtube) return;

      // Clear any previous iframe
      DOM.video.youtube.replaceChildren();

      const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
      // Autoplay muted (required by modern autoplay policies), privacy-enhanced host
      const params = new URLSearchParams({
        autoplay: '1',
        mute: '0',
        playsinline: '1',
        rel: '0',
        modestbranding: '1'
        // add extras if you like: controls=1, start=xx, end=yy, cc_load_policy=1, etc.
      });

      iframe.src = `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/${encodeURIComponent(videoId)}?${params.toString()}`;
      iframe.setAttribute('title', 'YouTube video player');
      iframe.setAttribute('frameborder', '0');
      iframe.setAttribute('allow',
        'autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture; accelerometer; gyroscope');
      iframe.allowFullscreen = true;
      iframe.style.cssText = 'border:none;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;';

      DOM.video.youtube.appendChild(iframe);
    }

    function createStreamPlayer(id) {
      if (!DOM.video.stream) return;

      const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
      DOM.video.stream.replaceChildren();
      iframe.src = `https://customer-vonlksqj0yyd6d75.cloudflarestream.com/${id}/iframe`;
      iframe.setAttribute('style', 'border:none;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;height:100%;width:100%;');
      iframe.allow = 'accelerometer; gyroscope; autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture;';
      iframe.allowFullscreen = true;
      DOM.video.stream.append(iframe);
    }

    function openModal(options) {
      DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.add(classes.modal.active);

      if (options.youtube) {
        insertYouTubeIframeAutoplay(options.youtube);
        DOM.video.youtube.classList.add('video-modal-active');
        DOM.video.stream.classList.remove('video-modal-active');
      } else if (options.stream) {
        createStreamPlayer(options.stream);
        DOM.video.youtube.classList.remove('video-modal-active');
        DOM.video.stream.classList.add('video-modal-active');
      }

      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('video-modal-opened'));
    }

    // ---- Early exits / DOM wiring ----
    if (!DOM.modal.wrapper) return;

    DOM.modal.content = DOM.modal.wrapper.querySelector('.modal');
    DOM.modal.close = DOM.modal.wrapper.querySelector('.modal-pricing-item--close-button');
    DOM.video.youtube = DOM.modal.wrapper.querySelector('.modal-fill.youtube');
    DOM.video.stream = DOM.modal.wrapper.querySelector('.modal-fill.stream');
    DOM.triggers.youtube = document.querySelectorAll('[data-youtube-id]');
    DOM.triggers.stream = document.querySelectorAll('[data-stream-id]');

    // ---- Triggers (no YouTube network until click) ----
    DOM.triggers.youtube.forEach(function (el) {
      const id = el.getAttribute('data-youtube-id');
      if (!id) return;
      el.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.contains(classes.modal.active)) return;
        openModal({ youtube: id }); // injects nocookie iframe with autoplay=1&mute=1
      });
    });

    DOM.triggers.stream.forEach(function (el) {
      const id = el.getAttribute('data-stream-id');
      if (!id) return;
      el.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.contains(classes.modal.active)) return;
        openModal({ stream: id });
      });
    });

    // ---- Modal interactions ----
    if (DOM.modal.content) {
      DOM.modal.content.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); });
    }

    if (DOM.modal.close) {
      DOM.modal.close.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        closeModal();
      });
    }

    window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.contains(classes.modal.active) && e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        closeModal();
      }
    });

    // Close when clicking the backdrop (not inside modal content)
    DOM.modal.wrapper.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      if (e.target === DOM.modal.wrapper) {
        e.preventDefault();
        closeModal();
      }
    });

    // Play arbitrary ID
    window.addEventListener('video-modal__play-video', function (e) {
      const modalArgs = {};
      if (e.detail && e.detail.type && (e.detail.type === 'stream' || e.detail.type === 'youtube') && e.detail.id) {
        modalArgs[e.detail.type] = e.detail.id;
        openModal(modalArgs);
      }
    });
  });
})();

          posterDOM.video.autoplay = !canHover;
          posterDOM.video.muted = true;
          posterDOM.video.loop = true;
          posterDOM.video.playsInline = true;
          posterDOM.video.preload = 'none';

          let player = null;
          let inView = true;

          function setSource() {
            const isDesktop = window.matchMedia('(width >= 768px)').matches;

            if (isDesktop && streamIds.desktop) {
              player.loadSource(`https://customer-${customerId}.cloudflarestream.com/${streamIds.desktop}/manifest/video.m3u8`);
            } else if (!isDesktop && streamIds.mobile) {
              player.loadSource(`https://customer-${customerId}.cloudflarestream.com/${streamIds.mobile}/manifest/video.m3u8`);
              // Cascade to the next available stream Id, if available play, otherwise do nothing
            } else {
              const finalStreamId = streamIds.desktop ?? streamIds.mobile ?? null;

              if (finalStreamId) {
                player.loadSource(`https://customer-${customerId}.cloudflarestream.com/${finalStreamId}/manifest/video.m3u8`);
              }
            }
          }

          function createPlayer() {
            if (player) return;
            player = new Hls({
              startLevel: -1,
            });
            player.autoLevelCapping = false;
            player.attachMedia(posterDOM.video);
            player.on(Hls.Events.MEDIA_ATTACHED, function () {
              setSource();

              posterDOM.container.classList.add('ready');

              addEventListener(
                'resize',
                (function () {
                  const timer = new WeakMap();

                  return function () {
                    if (timer.has(posterDOM.video)) {
                      clearTimeout(posterDOM.video);
                    }

                    timer.set(
                      posterDOM.video,
                      setTimeout(function () {
                        setSource();
                        timer.delete(posterDOM.video);
                      }, 500),
                    );
                  };
                })(),
              );

              if (!canHover) {
                gsap.set(posterDOM.video, {
                  opacity: 1,
                });
              }
            });
          }

          function destroyPlayer() {
            if (!player) return;
            player.destroy();
            player = null;
            gsap.set(posterDOM.video, {
              opacity: 0,
            });
          }

          function stop() {
            posterDOM.video.pause();
            posterDOM.video.currentTime = 0;
            posterDOM.video.classList.remove('is-playing');
          }

          // Lifecycle stays on the viewport, as the original did, to cap memory
          // when several cards are on screen at once. Playback is hover only.
          if (typeof IntersectionObserver !== 'undefined') {
            inView = false;
            const io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
              inView = entries[0].isIntersecting;
              if (!inView) {
                stop();
              } else if (!canHover) {
                posterDOM.video.play();
              }
            });
            io.observe(posterDOM.video);
          }

          // BEGIN: Video play on hover
          if (canHover) {
            posterDOM.hover.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () {
              if (!inView) return;

              posterDOM.video.classList.add('is-playing');
              const p = posterDOM.video.play();
              if (p && p.catch) p.catch(function () {});
            });

            posterDOM.hover.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
              stop();
            });
          }
          // END: Video play on hover

          createPlayer();
        }
      };
    }

      new window.CWFrontend.GenericVideoPoster(DOMScript.closest('.kat26-video-content'));
    });

  (function () {
    const DOMScript = document.currentScript;

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
      const slidersDOM = {
        wrapper: DOMScript.closest('.kat26-logo-strips'),
        strips: [],
      };

      if (!slidersDOM.wrapper) {
        return;
      }

      slidersDOM.strips = slidersDOM.wrapper.querySelectorAll('.kat26-logo-strip-wrapper');
      const isCMS = slidersDOM.wrapper.getAttribute('data-cms') === 'True';

      // First third = Intro
      // Next thirds = looping animation
      slidersDOM.strips.forEach((DOMStrip) => {
        const sliderDOM = {
          strip: DOMStrip.querySelector('.kat26-logo-strip'),
          items: null,
        };
        const timeline = gsap.timeline({
          scrollTrigger: {
            trigger: slidersDOM.wrapper,
            start: 'top 80%',
          },
        });
        const timers = {
          resume: {
            timeout: null,
            delay: 3000,
          },
        };
        const scrollTime = 120;

        // Dupe slides x2 if CMS
        if (isCMS) {
          for (let c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
            sliderDOM.strip.querySelectorAll('.w-dyn-item').forEach((DOMItem) => {
              const DOMClone = DOMItem.cloneNode(true);

              sliderDOM.strip.append(DOMClone);
            });
          }
        }

        sliderDOM.items = sliderDOM.strip.querySelectorAll('.kat26-logo-tile');
        const third = Math.floor(sliderDOM.items.length / 3);

        // Direction
        if (DOMStrip.classList.contains('right')) {
          // Items intro
          gsap.from([...sliderDOM.items].reverse().slice(0, third), {
            y: '+=20%',
            opacity: 0,
            stagger: 0.25,
            duration: 2,
            scrollTrigger: {
              trigger: slidersDOM.wrapper,
              start: 'top 80%',
            },
          });

          timeline.to(sliderDOM.strip, { duration: scrollTime, x: '+=33.33%', ease: 'none' }).to(sliderDOM.strip, { duration: scrollTime, x: '+=33.33%', repeat: -1, ease: 'none' });
          // Default to left
        } else {
          // Items intro
          gsap.from([...sliderDOM.items].slice(0, third), {
            y: '+=20%',
            opacity: 0,
            stagger: 0.25,
            duration: 2,
            scrollTrigger: {
              trigger: slidersDOM.wrapper,
              start: 'top 80%',
            },
          });

          timeline.to(sliderDOM.strip, { duration: scrollTime, x: '-=33.33%', ease: 'none' }).to(sliderDOM.strip, { duration: scrollTime, x: '-=33.33%', repeat: -1, ease: 'none' });
        }

        // BEGIN: Pause timeline on mousemove
        sliderDOM.strip.addEventListener('mousemove', () => {
          if (timers.resume.timeout !== null) {
            clearTImeout(timers.resume.timeout);
            timers.resume.timeout = null;
          }

          timeline.pause();

          timers.resume.timeout = setTimeout(() => {
            timeline.play();
            timers.resume.timeout = null;
          }, timers.resume.delay);
        });
        // END: Pause timeline on mousemove
      });
    });
  })();

  // Script to handle posters in the KAT26 Generic Video Element v3
  (function () {
    const DOMScript = document.currentScript;
    window.CWFrontend = window.CWFrontend ?? {}; // Global CW namespace

    if (!window.CWFrontend.GenericVideoPoster) {
      window.CWFrontend.GenericVideoPoster = class {
        constructor(DOMRoot) {
          const posterDOM = {
            wrapper: DOMRoot,
            container: null,
            hover: null,
            poster: null,
          };

          if (!posterDOM.wrapper) return;

          posterDOM.container = posterDOM.wrapper.querySelector('.video-placeholder-container');
          posterDOM.video = posterDOM.wrapper.querySelector('.video-placeholder-container video.poster');

          // Early exit if there are no videos to work with
          if (!posterDOM.video) {
            // Immediately render poster if available
            if (posterDOM.container) {
              posterDOM.container.classList.add('ready');
            }
            return;
          }

          // Hover the whole card when the tile exposes the hook, otherwise the media area.
          posterDOM.hover = posterDOM.wrapper.closest('[data-cw-hover-card]') || posterDOM.wrapper;
          const canHover = posterDOM.wrapper.getAttribute('data-poster-hover') === 'False'; // Flipped here 'True' for autoplay, 'False' for hover

          const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

          // Cloudflare Stream
          const customerId = posterDOM.wrapper.getAttribute('data-stream-customer-id');
          const streamIds = {
            desktop: posterDOM.video.getAttribute('data-desktop-id'),
            mobile: posterDOM.video.getAttribute('data-mobile-id'),
          };

          // No Cloudflare ID, no HLS, touch device, or reduced motion:
          // leave the static poster image exactly as it is.
          if (!customerId || !(streamIds.desktop || streamIds.mobile) || typeof Hls === 'undefined' || !Hls.isSupported() || reduceMotion) {
            return;
          }

          // The markup carries autoplay. Hover must own playback instead.
          //posterDOM.video.removeAttribute('autoplay');
          posterDOM.video.autoplay = !canHover;
          posterDOM.video.muted = true;
          posterDOM.video.loop = true;
          posterDOM.video.playsInline = true;
          posterDOM.video.preload = 'none';

          let player = null;
          let inView = true;

          function setSource() {
            const isDesktop = window.matchMedia('(width >= 768px)').matches;

            if (isDesktop && streamIds.desktop) {
              player.loadSource(`https://customer-${customerId}.cloudflarestream.com/${streamIds.desktop}/manifest/video.m3u8`);
            } else if (!isDesktop && streamIds.mobile) {
              player.loadSource(`https://customer-${customerId}.cloudflarestream.com/${streamIds.mobile}/manifest/video.m3u8`);
              // Cascade to the next available stream Id, if available play, otherwise do nothing
            } else {
              const finalStreamId = streamIds.desktop ?? streamIds.mobile ?? null;

              if (finalStreamId) {
                player.loadSource(`https://customer-${customerId}.cloudflarestream.com/${finalStreamId}/manifest/video.m3u8`);
              }
            }
          }

          function createPlayer() {
            if (player) return;
            player = new Hls({
              startLevel: -1,
            });
            player.autoLevelCapping = false;
            player.attachMedia(posterDOM.video);
            player.on(Hls.Events.MEDIA_ATTACHED, function () {
              setSource();

              posterDOM.container.classList.add('ready');

              addEventListener(
                'resize',
                (function () {
                  const timer = new WeakMap();

                  return function () {
                    if (timer.has(posterDOM.video)) {
                      clearTimeout(posterDOM.video);
                    }

                    timer.set(
                      posterDOM.video,
                      setTimeout(function () {
                        setSource();
                        timer.delete(posterDOM.video);
                      }, 500),
                    );
                  };
                })(),
              );

              if (!canHover) {
                gsap.set(posterDOM.video, {
                  opacity: 1,
                });
              }
            });
          }

          function destroyPlayer() {
            if (!player) return;
            player.destroy();
            player = null;
            gsap.set(posterDOM.video, {
              opacity: 0,
            });
          }

          function stop() {
            posterDOM.video.pause();
            posterDOM.video.currentTime = 0;
            posterDOM.video.classList.remove('is-playing');
          }

          // Lifecycle stays on the viewport, as the original did, to cap memory
          // when several cards are on screen at once. Playback is hover only.
          if (typeof IntersectionObserver !== 'undefined') {
            inView = false;
            const io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
              inView = entries[0].isIntersecting;
              if (!inView) {
                stop();
              } else if (!canHover) {
                posterDOM.video.play();
              }
            });
            io.observe(posterDOM.video);
          }

          // BEGIN: Video play on hover
          if (canHover) {
            posterDOM.hover.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () {
              if (!inView) return;

              posterDOM.video.classList.add('is-playing');
              const p = posterDOM.video.play();
              if (p && p.catch) p.catch(function () {});
            });

            posterDOM.hover.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
              stop();
            });
          }
          // END: Video play on hover

          createPlayer();
        }
      };
    }

      new window.CWFrontend.GenericVideoPoster(DOMScript.closest('.kat26-video-content'));
    });
  })();

            sliderDOM.dot.wrapper.replaceChildren();
            sliderDOM.dot.dots.splice(0);

            for (let i = 0; i <= maxIndex; i++) {
              const newDot = sliderDOM.dot.template.cloneNode(true);
              if (i === 0) {
                newDot.classList.add('kat26-slider-dot--active');
              } else {
                newDot.classList.remove('kat26-slider-dot--active');
              }

              sliderDOM.dot.dots.push(newDot);
              sliderDOM.dot.wrapper.append(newDot);
            }

            sliderDOM.dot.dots.forEach((DOMDot, index) => {
              const clickHandler = clickHandlerFactory(index);

              DOMDot.addEventListener('click', clickHandler);

              dotClickHandlers.push({ DOM: DOMDot, handler: clickHandler });
            });
          }

          function getMaxX() {
            const firstSlide = sliderDOM.items[0];
            let maxX = 0;

            if (centered) {
              const wrapperWidth = sliderDOM.wrapper.getBoundingClientRect().width;
              const slideWidth = firstSlide.getBoundingClientRect().width;
              maxX = (wrapperWidth - slideWidth) / 2;
            }

            return maxX;
          }

          function getMinX() {
            const lastSlide = sliderDOM.items[sliderDOM.items.length - 1];
            let minX = 0;

            if (centered) {
              const wrapperWidth = sliderDOM.wrapper.getBoundingClientRect().width;
              const slideWidth = lastSlide.getBoundingClientRect().width;

              minX = (wrapperWidth - slideWidth) / 2 - lastSlide.offsetLeft;
            } else if (rightAligned) {
              minX = -lastSlide.offsetLeft;
            } else {
              minX = sliderDOM.itemWrapper.getBoundingClientRect().width - (lastSlide.offsetLeft + lastSlide.getBoundingClientRect().width);
            }

            return minX;
          }

          function getMaxIndex() {
            let displayCount = 0;
            let result = 0;

            if (centered) {
              displayCount = 0;
              result = sliderDOM.items.length - 1;
            } else {
              displayCount = Math.floor(sliderDOM.itemWrapper.getBoundingClientRect().width / sliderDOM.items[0].getBoundingClientRect().width);
              result = sliderDOM.items.length - displayCount;
            }
            // -1 for zero indexing
            return result;
          }

          /////////////////////////////////////////////
          // BEGIN: Auto-slide timing
          /////////////////////////////////////////////
          const DEFAULT_DELAY = 3000;
          const RESUME_OFFSET = 5000;
          let autoscrollDelay = sliderDOM.wrapper.hasAttribute('data-autoscroll-delay') && sliderDOM.wrapper.getAttribute('data-autoscroll-delay').length ? parseInt(sliderDOM.wrapper.getAttribute('data-autoscroll-delay')) : DEFAULT_DELAY;

          const timers = {
            auto: {
              timer: null,
              delay: autoscrollDelay,
            },
            resume: {
              timer: null,
              delay: RESUME_OFFSET,
            },
          };
          /////////////////////////////////////////////
          // END: Auto-slide timing
          /////////////////////////////////////////////

          const auto = sliderDOM.wrapper.getAttribute('data-autoscroll') === 'True';
          const centered = false; // sliderDOM.wrapper.getAttribute('data-centered-slides') === 'True';
          const rightAligned = sliderDOM.wrapper.getAttribute('data-right-aligned') === 'True';
          const prefersReducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
          let draggable = null;
          let currentIndex = 0;
          let maxIndex = getMaxIndex();
          let dotClickHandlers = [];

          function getItemAtPosition(x, direction) {
            const absX = Math.abs(x);
            let result = {
              index: 0,
              item: sliderDOM.items[0],
            };

            // This assumes slides are relatively large
            // if (centered && typeof direction === 'string') {
            const sliderBounds = sliderDOM.wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
            const inBounds = [];

            // Get all slides that are within slider bounds
            sliderDOM.items.forEach((DOMItem, itemIndex) => {
              const slideBounds = DOMItem.getBoundingClientRect();

              // AABB Test on x axis only
              const isInBounds = sliderBounds.x < slideBounds.x + slideBounds.width && sliderBounds.x + sliderBounds.width > slideBounds.x;
              const overlap = Math.min(sliderBounds.x + sliderBounds.width, slideBounds.x + Math.round(slideBounds.width)) - Math.max(sliderBounds.x, slideBounds.x);

              if (isInBounds) {
                inBounds.push({
                  index: itemIndex,
                  item: DOMItem,
                  overlap: overlap,
                });
              }
            });

            // Sort by overlap
            inBounds.sort((a, b) => {
              // Primary sort by overlap (higher overlap = better match)
              if (a.overlap !== b.overlap) {
                return b.overlap - a.overlap;
              }

              // Secondary sort by index based on direction
              const aIndex = a.index;
              const bIndex = b.index;

              if (direction === 'left') {
                // Prefer items that appear more to the left
                return bIndex - aIndex;
              } else if (direction === 'right') {
                // Prefer items that appear more to the right
                return aIndex - bIndex;
              }

              // Default: fall back to overlap only
              return 0;
            });

            // Take the first result after sorting
            if (inBounds.length > 0) {
              result = inBounds[0];
            }

            return result;
          }

          function recalculate() {
            draggable.applyBounds({
              maxX: getMaxX(),
              minX: getMinX(),
            });

            gsap.set(sliderDOM.itemWrapper, { x: draggable.maxX });

            draggable.update();

            currentIndex = 0;
            updateArrows();
            buildDots();
          }

          function clearTimers() {
            if (timers.auto.timer) {
              clearInterval(timers.auto.timer);
              timers.auto.timer = null;
            }

            if (timers.resume.timer) {
              clearTimeout(timers.resume.timer);
              timers.resume.timer = null;
            }
          }

          function resumeTimers() {
            clearTimers();

            if (!auto || prefersReducedMotion) {
              return;
            }

            timers.resume.timer = setTimeout(function () {
              startTimers();
              timers.resume.timer = null;
            }, timers.resume.delay);
          }

          function updateArrows() {
            if (currentIndex === 0) {
              gsap.set(sliderDOM.arrows.right, { opacity: 0.4 });
              gsap.set(sliderDOM.arrows.left, { opacity: 1 });
            } else if (currentIndex === maxIndex) {
              gsap.set(sliderDOM.arrows.right, { opacity: 1 });
              gsap.set(sliderDOM.arrows.left, { opacity: 0.4 });
            } else {
              gsap.set(sliderDOM.arrows.right, { visibility: 1 });
              gsap.set(sliderDOM.arrows.left, { visibility: 1 });
            }
          }

          // Kicks off progress and loops
          function startTimers() {
            clearTimers();

            if (!auto || prefersReducedMotion) {
              return;
            }

            timers.auto.timer = setInterval(function () {
              currentIndex++;
              currentIndex = currentIndex >= sliderDOM.dot.dots.length ? 0 : currentIndex;
              goto(currentIndex);
            }, timers.auto.delay);
          }

          function goto(index) {
            const currentMinX = getMinX();

            index = index < 0 ? maxIndex : index;
            index = index > maxIndex ? 0 : index;

            let targetX = 0;

            if (centered) {
              const sliderWidth = sliderDOM.wrapper.getBoundingClientRect().width;
              const slideWidth = sliderDOM.items[index].getBoundingClientRect().width;
              targetX = (sliderWidth - slideWidth) / 2 - sliderDOM.items[index].offsetLeft;
            } else {
              targetX = Math.round(-sliderDOM.items[index].offsetLeft);
            }

            targetX = targetX < currentMinX ? currentMinX : targetX;

            if (draggable.tween) {
              draggable.tween.kill();
            }

            gsap.to(sliderDOM.itemWrapper, {
              x: targetX,
              onComplete: function () {
                clearSlideActive().classList.add('active');
                sliderDOM.items[index].dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('kat26-slider__slide-active', { bubbles: true }));
                draggable.update();
              },
            });

            currentIndex = index;
            updateArrows();

            updateDots();
          }

          function clearSlideActive() {
            sliderDOM.items.forEach((DOMItem) => {
              DOMItem.classList.remove('active');
            });

            return sliderDOM.items[currentIndex];
          }

          function updateDots() {
            sliderDOM.dot.dots.forEach((DOMDot) => {
              DOMDot.classList.remove('kat26-slider-dot--active');
            });

            if (currentIndex >= sliderDOM.dot.dots.length) {
              return;
            }

            sliderDOM.dot.dots[currentIndex].classList.add('kat26-slider-dot--active');
          }

          function clickHandlerFactory(index) {
            const handler = function (e) {
              e.preventDefault();

              resumeTimers();

              goto(index);
            };

            return handler;
          }

          draggable = Draggable.create(sliderDOM.itemWrapper, {
            type: 'x',
            bounds: {
              maxX: getMaxX(),
              minX: getMinX(),
            },
            inertia: true,
            onDragStart: function () {
              clearTimers();

              clearSlideActive();
            },
            onDrag: function () {
              let newIndex = getItemAtPosition(this.x, this.getDirection()).index;
              //Math.floor(Math.abs(this.x) / getSlideWidth()) + 1;

              newIndex = newIndex >= maxIndex ? maxIndex : newIndex;
              newIndex = newIndex < 0 ? 0 : newIndex;

              currentIndex = newIndex;

              updateArrows();

              clearSlideActive().classList.add('active');

              updateDots();
            },
            snap: function (endValue) {
              // Snap targets for every slide, same math as goto()
              const wrapperWidth = sliderDOM.wrapper.getBoundingClientRect().width;
              const points = sliderDOM.items.map((DOMItem) => {
                if (centered) {
                  return (wrapperWidth - DOMItem.getBoundingClientRect().width) / 2 - DOMItem.offsetLeft;
                }

                return -DOMItem.offsetLeft;
              });

              const nearest = (x) => points.reduce((best, p, i) => (Math.abs(p - x) < Math.abs(points[best] - x) ? i : best), 0);

              // endValue is InertiaPlugin's velocity-projected landing position, so a
              // quick flick advances even when the pointer only moved a short distance
              const projected = typeof endValue === 'number' && isFinite(endValue) ? endValue : this.x;
              let newIndex = nearest(projected);

              // A slow drag past 20% of the slide width advances even without flick velocity
              const startIndex = nearest(this.startX);
              const delta = this.x - this.startX;
              const slideWidth = sliderDOM.items[startIndex].getBoundingClientRect().width;

              if (newIndex === startIndex && Math.abs(delta) > slideWidth * 0.2) {
                newIndex = Math.min(sliderDOM.items.length - 1, Math.max(0, startIndex + (delta < 0 ? 1 : -1)));
              }

              currentIndex = Math.min(newIndex, maxIndex);

              updateArrows();

              clearSlideActive().classList.add('active');

              return Math.min(this.maxX, Math.max(this.minX, points[newIndex]));
            },
            onThrowComplete: function () {
              updateDots();
              resumeTimers();
            },
          })[0];

          gsap.set(sliderDOM.itemWrapper, { x: draggable.maxX });
          sliderDOM.items[0].classList.add('active');

          draggable.update();

          window.addEventListener('resize', recalculate);

          /////////////////////////////////////////////
          // BEGIN: Arrow handling
          /////////////////////////////////////////////

          // Previous slide
          sliderDOM.arrows.left.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.preventDefault();

            goto(currentIndex + 1);
            resumeTimers();
          });

          // Next slide
          sliderDOM.arrows.right.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.preventDefault();

            goto(currentIndex - 1);
            resumeTimers();
          });
          /////////////////////////////////////////////
          // END: arrow Handling
          /////////////////////////////////////////////

          /////////////////////////////////////////////
          // BEGIN: Recalculate
          // Update changes in items
          /////////////////////////////////////////////
          sliderDOM.wrapper.addEventListener('kat26-slider-recalculate', () => {
            sliderDOM.items = [...sliderDOM.itemWrapper.children].filter((DOMItem) => DOMItem.checkVisibility());
            currentIndex = 0;
            recalculate();
            resumeTimers();
          });
          /////////////////////////////////////////////
          // END: Recalculate
          /////////////////////////////////////////////

          /////////////////////////////////////////////
          // BEGIN: Generic Video Element Integration
          /////////////////////////////////////////////
          let hasVideoPlaying = false;
          sliderDOM.wrapper.addEventListener('generic-video__playing', () => {
            hasVideoPlaying = true;
            clearTimers();
          });

          sliderDOM.wrapper.addEventListener('generic-video__stopped', () => {
            hasVideoPlaying = false;
            resumeTimers();
          });
          /////////////////////////////////////////////
          // END: Generic Video Element Integration
          /////////////////////////////////////////////

          /////////////////////////////////////////////
          // BEGIN: Intersection Observer
          /////////////////////////////////////////////
          if (typeof IntersectionObserver !== 'undefined') {
            let inView = false;
            const io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
              inView = entries[0].isIntersecting;
              if (!inView) {
                clearTimers();
              } else {
                resumeTimers();
              }
            });
            io.observe(sliderDOM.wrapper);
          }
          /////////////////////////////////////////////
          // END: Intersection Observer
          /////////////////////////////////////////////

          updateArrows();
          buildDots();

          // Kick off slider auto progression
          document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
            if (document.hidden) {
              clearTimers();
            } else {
              // If a Generic Video Element is playing, do not resume autoscroll
              if (hasVideoPlaying) {
                return;
              }

              resumeTimers();
            }
          });
          startTimers();
        }
      };
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
      new window.CWFrontend.Slider(DOMScript.closest('.kat26-slider-wrapper'));
    });
  })();

  // Script to handle posters in the KAT26 Generic Video Element v3
  (function () {
    const DOMScript = document.currentScript;
    window.CWFrontend = window.CWFrontend ?? {}; // Global CW namespace

    if (!window.CWFrontend.GenericVideoPoster) {
      window.CWFrontend.GenericVideoPoster = class {
        constructor(DOMRoot) {
          const posterDOM = {
            wrapper: DOMRoot,
            container: null,
            hover: null,
            poster: null,
          };

          if (!posterDOM.wrapper) return;

          posterDOM.container = posterDOM.wrapper.querySelector('.video-placeholder-container');
          posterDOM.video = posterDOM.wrapper.querySelector('.video-placeholder-container video.poster');

          // Early exit if there are no videos to work with
          if (!posterDOM.video) {
            // Immediately render poster if available
            if (posterDOM.container) {
              posterDOM.container.classList.add('ready');
            }
            return;
          }

          // Hover the whole card when the tile exposes the hook, otherwise the media area.
          posterDOM.hover = posterDOM.wrapper.closest('[data-cw-hover-card]') || posterDOM.wrapper;
          const canHover = posterDOM.wrapper.getAttribute('data-poster-hover') === 'False'; // Flipped here 'True' for autoplay, 'False' for hover

          const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

          // Cloudflare Stream
          const customerId = posterDOM.wrapper.getAttribute('data-stream-customer-id');
          const streamIds = {
            desktop: posterDOM.video.getAttribute('data-desktop-id'),
            mobile: posterDOM.video.getAttribute('data-mobile-id'),
          };

          // No Cloudflare ID, no HLS, touch device, or reduced motion:
          // leave the static poster image exactly as it is.
          if (!customerId || !(streamIds.desktop || streamIds.mobile) || typeof Hls === 'undefined' || !Hls.isSupported() || reduceMotion) {
            return;
          }

          // The markup carries autoplay. Hover must own playback instead.
          //posterDOM.video.removeAttribute('autoplay');
          posterDOM.video.autoplay = !canHover;
          posterDOM.video.muted = true;
          posterDOM.video.loop = true;
          posterDOM.video.playsInline = true;
          posterDOM.video.preload = 'none';

          let player = null;
          let inView = true;

          function setSource() {
            const isDesktop = window.matchMedia('(width >= 768px)').matches;

            if (isDesktop && streamIds.desktop) {
              player.loadSource(`https://customer-${customerId}.cloudflarestream.com/${streamIds.desktop}/manifest/video.m3u8`);
            } else if (!isDesktop && streamIds.mobile) {
              player.loadSource(`https://customer-${customerId}.cloudflarestream.com/${streamIds.mobile}/manifest/video.m3u8`);
              // Cascade to the next available stream Id, if available play, otherwise do nothing
            } else {
              const finalStreamId = streamIds.desktop ?? streamIds.mobile ?? null;

              if (finalStreamId) {
                player.loadSource(`https://customer-${customerId}.cloudflarestream.com/${finalStreamId}/manifest/video.m3u8`);
              }
            }
          }

          function createPlayer() {
            if (player) return;
            player = new Hls({
              startLevel: -1,
            });
            player.autoLevelCapping = false;
            player.attachMedia(posterDOM.video);
            player.on(Hls.Events.MEDIA_ATTACHED, function () {
              setSource();

              posterDOM.container.classList.add('ready');

              addEventListener(

                  const timer = new WeakMap();

                  return function () {
                    if (timer.has(posterDOM.video)) {
                      clearTimeout(posterDOM.video);
                    }

                    timer.set(
                      posterDOM.video,
                      setTimeout(function () {
                        setSource();
                        timer.delete(posterDOM.video);
                      }, 500),
                    );
                  };
                })(),
              );

              if (!canHover) {
                gsap.set(posterDOM.video, {
                  opacity: 1,
                });
              }
            });
          }

          function destroyPlayer() {
            if (!player) return;
            player.destroy();
            player = null;
            gsap.set(posterDOM.video, {
              opacity: 0,
            });
          }

          function stop() {
            posterDOM.video.pause();
            posterDOM.video.currentTime = 0;
            posterDOM.video.classList.remove('is-playing');
          }

          // Lifecycle stays on the viewport, as the original did, to cap memory
          // when several cards are on screen at once. Playback is hover only.
          if (typeof IntersectionObserver !== 'undefined') {

            const io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {

          if (canHover) {
            posterDOM.hover.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () {
              if (!inView) return;

              posterDOM.video.classList.add('is-playing');
              const p = posterDOM.video.play();
              if (p && p.catch) p.catch(function () {});
            });

            posterDOM.hover.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
              stop();
            });
          }
          // END: Video play on hover

          createPlayer();
        }
      };
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
      new window.CWFrontend.GenericVideoPoster(DOMScript.closest('.kat26-video-content'));
    });
  })();

<script>
  class SimpleCarousel {
    constructor(options) {
      const _this = this;
      const DOM = {
        carousel: false,
        slides: false,
        dot: {
          container: false,
          template: false,
          all: [],
          classes: {
            active: 'dot--active',
          },
        },
        counter: {
          current: false,
          max: false,
        },
        slider: {
          slides: false,
        },
      };
      const time = {
        tween: false,
        resume: {
          timer: false,
          delay: 6,
        },
        delay: 6,
      };
      const slider = {
        current: 0,
        max: 0,
        stopped: true,
      };

      this.blur = function () {
        const time = _this.time;

        if (time.tween) {
          time.tween.pause();
        }

        if (time.resume.timer) {
          clearTimeout(time.resume.timer);
          time.resume.timer = false;
        }
      };

      this.focus = function () {
        const slider = _this.slider;

        if (!slider.stopped || slider.max <= 1) {

        e.stopPropagation();

              // Assumes first child is the templaate
              DOM.dot.all[0].push(DOMDotContainer.children[0]);

            for (i = 1; i < slider.max; i++) {

                DOMNewDot.classList.remove(DOM.dot.classes.active);

    /**

    pauseTimers(resume) {

</style></div><div class="kat26-navbar-script w-embed w-script"><script>
<script>
(function () {
  const DOMScript = document.currentScript;

  function init() {
    const menuDOM = {
      wrapper: (DOMScript && DOMScript.closest('.kat26-navbar-container')) || document.querySelector('.kat26-navbar-container')
    };

    if (!menuDOM.wrapper) {
      return;
    }

    const hasGsap = typeof gsap !== 'undefined';
    const desktopQuery = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 992px)');

    // Toggle a Webflow dropdown the way Webflow expects. Its dropdown module listens on the toggle for a native
    // 'mouseup' (mouse devices) or 'click' (touch devices); jQuery's 'tap' is only an alias for click, so a
    // trigger('tap') never opens a dropdown on desktop.
    function tapToggle(DOMToggle) {
      if (!DOMToggle) {
        return;
      }

      // Webflow binds the toggle to 'mouseup' on mouse devices and to 'click' on touch devices, so send both.
      DOMToggle.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0, buttons: 1 }));
      DOMToggle.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0 }));
      DOMToggle.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0 }));
    }

    function closeOpenDropdowns(except) {
      menuDOM.wrapper.querySelectorAll('.kat26-navbar-dropdown').forEach(DOMDropdown => {
        if (DOMDropdown === except) {
          return;
        }

        tapToggle(DOMDropdown.querySelector(':scope > .w-dropdown-toggle.w--open'));
      });
    }

    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // BEGIN: Hover control (native dropdown hover suppressed; desktop hover with grace, mobile tap-only)
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    (function () {
      const GRACE_MS = 180; // Used to prevent "instant" menu opens
      let timer = null; // This is a global timer

      // Verify if there's a current open nav
      function hasOpenNav() {
        return menuDOM.wrapper.querySelectorAll('.w--open').length !== 0;
      }

      menuDOM.wrapper.querySelectorAll('.kat26-navbar-dropdown').forEach(DOMDropdown => {
        const DOMToggle = DOMDropdown.querySelector(':scope > .w-dropdown-toggle');

        if (!DOMToggle) {
          return;
        }

        function setOpen() {
          if (!DOMToggle.classList.contains('w--open')) {
            closeOpenDropdowns(DOMDropdown);
            tapToggle(DOMToggle);
          }
        }

        // Webflow binds its own hover open/close through jQuery mouseenter/mouseleave, which jQuery
        // implements on mouseover/mouseout. Stop those at the wrapper (capture phase) so the native
        // hover never fires: below 992px the drawer becomes tap-only, above it the handlers below take over
        // with a grace period. Native mouseenter/mouseleave used here are unaffected.
        ['mouseover', 'mouseout'].forEach(type => {
          DOMDropdown.addEventListener(type, function (e) {
            e.stopImmediatePropagation();
          }, true);
        });

        DOMDropdown.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () {
          if (!desktopQuery.matches) {
            return;
          }

          clearTimeout(timer);

          // Do not wait, open immediately
          if (hasOpenNav()) {
            setOpen();
            // Wait for a few MS to avoid unintended menu opens
          } else {
            timer = setTimeout(() => {
              setOpen();
            }, GRACE_MS);
          }
        });

        DOMDropdown.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
          if (!desktopQuery.matches) {
            return;
          }

          clearTimeout(timer);

          if (DOMToggle.classList.contains('w--open')) {
            tapToggle(DOMToggle);
          }

        });
      });
    })();
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // END: Hover control
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // BEGIN: Menu Interaction
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    (function () {
      if (!hasGsap) {
        return;
      }

      const buttonDOM = {
        nav: {
          toggles: menuDOM.wrapper.querySelectorAll('.w-dropdown-toggle')
        }
      };
      const matchMedia = gsap.matchMedia();

      matchMedia.add('(min-width: 992px)', () => {
        const hoverHandlers = [];

        buttonDOM.nav.toggles.forEach(DOMToggle => {
          const DOMSubNav = DOMToggle.parentElement.querySelector('.w-dropdown-list');
          const timeline = gsap.timeline();
          const observer = new MutationObserver((mutationList) => {
            mutationList.forEach(mutation => {
              if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && mutation.attributeName === 'class') {
                timeline.pause();
                timeline.clear();

                // Close -> Open
                if (DOMSubNav.classList.contains('w--open')) {
                  // From primary nav
                  if (DOMToggle.parentElement.classList.contains('kat26-navbar-dropdown')) {
                    const columnChildren = [];

                    timeline
                      .fromTo(DOMSubNav, { opacity: 0, display: 'none' }, { opacity: 1, display: 'block', duration: 0.3 })
                      .fromTo(DOMSubNav.querySelector('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-menu-wrapper'), { yPercent: -100 }, { yPercent: 0, duration: 0.3, clearProps: 'all' }, '-=0.3');

                    // Rows to cascade, in DOM order: column children, grid cells that are not columns, callouts, section titles, footers
                    DOMSubNav.querySelectorAll('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-column > *, .kat26-navbar-dropdown-grid > :not(.kat26-navbar-dropdown-column), .kat26-navbar-dropdown-callout, .kat26-navbar-dropdown-section-title, .kat26-navbar-dropdown-footer').forEach(DOMRow => {
                      columnChildren.push(DOMRow);
                    });

                    timeline
                      .fromTo(columnChildren, { opacity: 0, yPercent: -20 }, { opacity: 1, yPercent: 0, duration: 0.2, stagger: 0.05, clearProps: 'all' });
                  } else {
                    timeline
                      .fromTo(DOMSubNav, { opacity: 0, display: 'none' }, { opacity: 1, display: 'block', duration: 0.3 })
                      .fromTo(DOMSubNav.querySelector('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-column').children, { opacity: 0, yPercent: -20 }, { opacity: 1, yPercent: 0, duration: 0.2, stagger: 0.05, clearProps: 'all' });
                  }
                  // Open -> Close
                } else {
                  // From primary nav
                  if (DOMToggle.parentElement.classList.contains('kat26-navbar-dropdown')) {
                    timeline
                      .fromTo(DOMSubNav, { opacity: 1, display: 'block' }, { opacity: 0, display: 'none', duration: 0.3 })
                      .fromTo(DOMSubNav.querySelector('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-menu-wrapper'), { yPercent: 0 }, { yPercent: -100, duration: 0.3, clearProps: 'all' }, '-=0.3');
                  } else {
                    timeline.fromTo(DOMSubNav, { opacity: 1, display: 'block' }, { opacity: 0, display: 'none', duration: 0.3, clearProps: 'all' });

                  }
                }

                timeline.play();
              }
            });
          });

          observer.observe(DOMToggle, { attributes: true });

          hoverHandlers.push({
            DOM: {
              subNav: DOMSubNav
            },
            observer: observer
          });
        });

        return () => {
          hoverHandlers.forEach(hoverHandlerDatum => {
            const DOMSubNavWrapper = hoverHandlerDatum.DOM.subNav.querySelector('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-menu-wrapper');

            hoverHandlerDatum.DOM.subNav.removeAttribute('style');
            hoverHandlerDatum.observer.disconnect();

            if (DOMSubNavWrapper) {
              DOMSubNavWrapper.removeAttribute('style');
            }
          });
        };
      });
    })();
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // END: Menu Interaction
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // BEGIN: Products Menu
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    (function () {
      const productsDOM = {
        wrapper: null,
        nav: {
          wrapper: null,
          navs: [],
          subs: []
        }
      };

      productsDOM.wrapper = menuDOM.wrapper.querySelector('#kat26-menu-item-products');
      productsDOM.wrapper = productsDOM.wrapper ? productsDOM.wrapper.closest('.kat26-navbar-dropdown') : null;

      // No nested (has-menu) submenus in this nav; keep the block inert unless one is added back.
      if (!productsDOM.wrapper || !hasGsap) {
        return;
      }

      productsDOM.nav.wrapper = productsDOM.wrapper.querySelector('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-menu-wrapper');
      productsDOM.nav.navs = productsDOM.wrapper.querySelectorAll('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-item-has-menu .kat26-navbar-dropdown-item');
      productsDOM.nav.subs = productsDOM.wrapper.querySelectorAll('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-submenu');

      const matchMedia = gsap.matchMedia();

      matchMedia.add('(min-width: 992px)', () => {
        const observers = [];
        productsDOM.nav.navs.forEach(DOMSubNav => {
          const observer = new MutationObserver((mutationList) => {
            mutationList.forEach(mutation => {
              if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && mutation.attributeName === 'class') {
                if (DOMSubNav.classList.contains('w--open')) {
                  productsDOM.nav.subs.forEach(DOMSubMenu => {
                    gsap.set(DOMSubMenu, { height: `${Math.ceil(productsDOM.nav.wrapper.getBoundingClientRect().height)}px` });
                  });
                }
              }
            });
          });

          observer.observe(DOMSubNav, { attributes: true });

          observers.push(observer);
        });

        return () => {
          observers.forEach(observer => {
            observer.disconnect();
          });

          productsDOM.nav.subs.forEach(DOMSubMenu => {
            gsap.set(DOMSubMenu, { height: '' });
          });
        }
      });
    })();
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // END: Products Menu
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    // BEGIN: Menu Return (mobile "Main menu" link closes the open L2 screen)
    /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    (function () {
      menuDOM.wrapper.querySelectorAll('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-return').forEach(DOMDropdownReturn => {
        DOMDropdownReturn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();

<script>
(function () {
  const DOMScript = document.currentScript;

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const DOM = {
      triggers: { youtube: [], stream: [] },
      modal: {
        wrapper: DOMScript.closest('.modal-container'),
        content: null,
        close: null
      },
      video: { youtube: null, stream: null }
    };

    const classes = { modal: { active: 'modal-container--active' } };

    function closeModal() {
      if (!DOM.modal.wrapper) return;
      DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.remove(classes.modal.active);

      // Remove iframes to guarantee playback stops (YT + CF Stream)
      if (DOM.video.youtube) DOM.video.youtube.replaceChildren();
      if (DOM.video.stream) DOM.video.stream.replaceChildren();

      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('video-modal-closed'));
    }

    function insertYouTubeIframeAutoplay(videoId) {
      if (!DOM.video.youtube) return;

      // Clear any previous iframe
      DOM.video.youtube.replaceChildren();

      const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
      // Autoplay muted (required by modern autoplay policies), privacy-enhanced host
      const params = new URLSearchParams({
        autoplay: '1',
        mute: '0',
        playsinline: '1',
        rel: '0',
        modestbranding: '1'
        // add extras if you like: controls=1, start=xx, end=yy, cc_load_policy=1, etc.
      });

      iframe.src = `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/${encodeURIComponent(videoId)}?${params.toString()}`;
      iframe.setAttribute('title', 'YouTube video player');
      iframe.setAttribute('frameborder', '0');
      iframe.setAttribute('allow',
        'autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture; accelerometer; gyroscope');
      iframe.allowFullscreen = true;
      iframe.style.cssText = 'border:none;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;';

      DOM.video.youtube.appendChild(iframe);
    }

    function createStreamPlayer(id) {
      if (!DOM.video.stream) return;

      const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
      DOM.video.stream.replaceChildren();
      iframe.src = `https://customer-vonlksqj0yyd6d75.cloudflarestream.com/${id}/iframe`;
      iframe.setAttribute('style', 'border:none;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;height:100%;width:100%;');
      iframe.allow = 'accelerometer; gyroscope; autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture;';
      iframe.allowFullscreen = true;
      DOM.video.stream.append(iframe);
    }

    function openModal(options) {
      DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.add(classes.modal.active);

      if (options.youtube) {
        insertYouTubeIframeAutoplay(options.youtube);
        DOM.video.youtube.classList.add('video-modal-active');
        DOM.video.stream.classList.remove('video-modal-active');
      } else if (options.stream) {
        createStreamPlayer(options.stream);
        DOM.video.youtube.classList.remove('video-modal-active');
        DOM.video.stream.classList.add('video-modal-active');
      }

      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('video-modal-opened'));
    }

    // ---- Early exits / DOM wiring ----
    if (!DOM.modal.wrapper) return;

    DOM.modal.content = DOM.modal.wrapper.querySelector('.modal');
    DOM.modal.close = DOM.modal.wrapper.querySelector('.modal-pricing-item--close-button');
    DOM.video.youtube = DOM.modal.wrapper.querySelector('.modal-fill.youtube');
    DOM.video.stream = DOM.modal.wrapper.querySelector('.modal-fill.stream');
    DOM.triggers.youtube = document.querySelectorAll('[data-youtube-id]');
    DOM.triggers.stream = document.querySelectorAll('[data-stream-id]');

    // ---- Triggers (no YouTube network until click) ----
    DOM.triggers.youtube.forEach(function (el) {
      const id = el.getAttribute('data-youtube-id');
      if (!id) return;
      el.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.contains(classes.modal.active)) return;
        openModal({ youtube: id }); // injects nocookie iframe with autoplay=1&mute=1
      });
    });

    DOM.triggers.stream.forEach(function (el) {
      const id = el.getAttribute('data-stream-id');
      if (!id) return;
      el.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.contains(classes.modal.active)) return;
        openModal({ stream: id });
      });
    });

    // ---- Modal interactions ----
    if (DOM.modal.content) {
      DOM.modal.content.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); });
    }

    if (DOM.modal.close) {
      DOM.modal.close.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        closeModal();
      });
    }

    window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.contains(classes.modal.active) && e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        closeModal();
      }
    });

    // Close when clicking the backdrop (not inside modal content)
    DOM.modal.wrapper.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      if (e.target === DOM.modal.wrapper) {
        e.preventDefault();
        closeModal();
      }
    });

    // Play arbitrary ID
    window.addEventListener('video-modal__play-video', function (e) {
      const modalArgs = {};
      if (e.detail && e.detail.type && (e.detail.type === 'stream' || e.detail.type === 'youtube') && e.detail.id) {
        modalArgs[e.detail.type] = e.detail.id;
        openModal(modalArgs);
      }
    });
  });
})();

<script>
  class SimpleCarousel {
    constructor(options) {
      const _this = this;
      const DOM = {
        carousel: false,
        slides: false,
        dot: {
          container: false,
          template: false,
          all: [],
          classes: {
            active: 'dot--active',
          },
        },
        counter: {
          current: false,
          max: false,
        },
        slider: {
          slides: false,
        },
      };
      const time = {
        tween: false,
        resume: {
          timer: false,
          delay: 6,
        },
        delay: 6,
      };
      const slider = {
        current: 0,
        max: 0,
        stopped: true,
      };

      this.blur = function () {
        const time = _this.time;

        if (time.tween) {
          time.tween.pause();
        }

        if (time.resume.timer) {
          clearTimeout(time.resume.timer);
          time.resume.timer = false;
        }
      };

      this.focus = function () {
        const slider = _this.slider;

        if (!slider.stopped || slider.max <= 1) {
          _this.start();
        }
      };

      this.propagationStop = function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
      };

                      .fromTo(DOMSubNav, { opacity: 0, display: 'none' }, { opacity: 1, display: 'block', duration: 0.3 })

                  }

                } else {

                    timeline
                      .fromTo(DOMSubNav, { opacity: 1, display: 'block' }, { opacity: 0, display: 'none', duration: 0.3 })
                      .fromTo(DOMSubNav.querySelector('.kat26-navbar-dropdown-menu-wrapper'), { yPercent: 0 }, { yPercent: -100, duration: 0.3, clearProps: 'all' }, '-=0.3');

          observer.observe(DOMSubNav, { attributes: true });

          observers.push(observer);

            observer.disconnect();

<script>
(function () {
  const DOMScript = document.currentScript;

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const DOM = {
      triggers: { youtube: [], stream: [] },
      modal: {
        wrapper: DOMScript.closest('.modal-container'),
        content: null,
        close: null
      },
      video: { youtube: null, stream: null }
    };

    const classes = { modal: { active: 'modal-container--active' } };

    function closeModal() {
      if (!DOM.modal.wrapper) return;
      DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.remove(classes.modal.active);

      // Remove iframes to guarantee playback stops (YT + CF Stream)
      if (DOM.video.youtube) DOM.video.youtube.replaceChildren();
      if (DOM.video.stream) DOM.video.stream.replaceChildren();

      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('video-modal-closed'));
    }

    function insertYouTubeIframeAutoplay(videoId) {
      if (!DOM.video.youtube) return;

      // Clear any previous iframe
      DOM.video.youtube.replaceChildren();

      const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
      // Autoplay muted (required by modern autoplay policies), privacy-enhanced host
      const params = new URLSearchParams({
        autoplay: '1',
        mute: '0',
        playsinline: '1',
        rel: '0',
        modestbranding: '1'
        // add extras if you like: controls=1, start=xx, end=yy, cc_load_policy=1, etc.
      });

      iframe.src = `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/${encodeURIComponent(videoId)}?${params.toString()}`;
      iframe.setAttribute('title', 'YouTube video player');
      iframe.setAttribute('frameborder', '0');
      iframe.setAttribute('allow',
        'autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture; accelerometer; gyroscope');
      iframe.allowFullscreen = true;
      iframe.style.cssText = 'border:none;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;';

      DOM.video.youtube.appendChild(iframe);
    }

    function createStreamPlayer(id) {
      if (!DOM.video.stream) return;

      const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
      DOM.video.stream.replaceChildren();
      iframe.src = `https://customer-vonlksqj0yyd6d75.cloudflarestream.com/${id}/iframe`;
      iframe.setAttribute('style', 'border:none;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;height:100%;width:100%;');
      iframe.allow = 'accelerometer; gyroscope; autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture;';
      iframe.allowFullscreen = true;
      DOM.video.stream.append(iframe);
    }

    function openModal(options) {
      DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.add(classes.modal.active);

      if (options.youtube) {
        insertYouTubeIframeAutoplay(options.youtube);
        DOM.video.youtube.classList.add('video-modal-active');
        DOM.video.stream.classList.remove('video-modal-active');
      } else if (options.stream) {
        createStreamPlayer(options.stream);
        DOM.video.youtube.classList.remove('video-modal-active');
        DOM.video.stream.classList.add('video-modal-active');
      }

      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('video-modal-opened'));
    }

    // ---- Early exits / DOM wiring ----
    if (!DOM.modal.wrapper) return;

    DOM.modal.content = DOM.modal.wrapper.querySelector('.modal');
    DOM.modal.close = DOM.modal.wrapper.querySelector('.modal-pricing-item--close-button');
    DOM.video.youtube = DOM.modal.wrapper.querySelector('.modal-fill.youtube');
    DOM.video.stream = DOM.modal.wrapper.querySelector('.modal-fill.stream');
    DOM.triggers.youtube = document.querySelectorAll('[data-youtube-id]');
    DOM.triggers.stream = document.querySelectorAll('[data-stream-id]');

    // ---- Triggers (no YouTube network until click) ----
    DOM.triggers.youtube.forEach(function (el) {
      const id = el.getAttribute('data-youtube-id');
      if (!id) return;
      el.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.contains(classes.modal.active)) return;
        openModal({ youtube: id }); // injects nocookie iframe with autoplay=1&mute=1
      });
    });

    DOM.triggers.stream.forEach(function (el) {
      const id = el.getAttribute('data-stream-id');
      if (!id) return;
      el.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.contains(classes.modal.active)) return;
        openModal({ stream: id });
      });
    });

    // ---- Modal interactions ----
    if (DOM.modal.content) {
      DOM.modal.content.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); });
    }

    if (DOM.modal.close) {
      DOM.modal.close.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        closeModal();
      });
    }

    window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (DOM.modal.wrapper.classList.contains(classes.modal.active) && e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        closeModal();
      }
    });

    // Close when clicking the backdrop (not inside modal content)
    DOM.modal.wrapper.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      if (e.target === DOM.modal.wrapper) {
        e.preventDefault();
        closeModal();
      }
    });

    // Play arbitrary ID
    window.addEventListener('video-modal__play-video', function (e) {
      const modalArgs = {};
      if (e.detail && e.detail.type && (e.detail.type === 'stream' || e.detail.type === 'youtube') && e.detail.id) {
        modalArgs[e.detail.type] = e.detail.id;
        openModal(modalArgs);
      }
    });
  });
})();

<script>
  class SimpleCarousel {
    constructor(options) {
      const _this = this;
      const DOM = {
        carousel: false,
        slides: false,
        dot: {
          container: false,
          template: false,
          all: [],
          classes: {
            active: 'dot--active',
          },
        },
        counter: {
          current: false,
          max: false,
        },
        slider: {
          slides: false,
        },
      };
      const time = {
        tween: false,
        resume: {
          timer: false,
          delay: 6,
        },
        delay: 6,
      };
      const slider = {
        current: 0,
        max: 0,
        stopped: true,
      };

      this.blur = function () {
        const time = _this.time;

        if (time.tween) {
          time.tween.pause();
        }

        if (time.resume.timer) {
          clearTimeout(time.resume.timer);
          time.resume.timer = false;
        }

      this.focus = function () {
        const slider = _this.slider;

        if (!slider.stopped || slider.max <= 1) {
          _this.start();

      this.propagationStop = function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
      };

      this.eventHandlers = []; // For cleanup

      this.classes = {
        active: typeof options.classes !== 'undefined' && typeof options.classes.active === 'string' ? options.classes.active : 'simple-carousel--active',

      this.DOM = DOM;
      this.slider = slider;
      this.time = time;

      this.animate = typeof options.animate === 'boolean' || typeof options.animate === 'object' ? options.animate : true;
      this.auto = typeof options.auto === 'boolean' ? options.auto : true; // Auto progression default to true
      this.scrollFocus = typeof options.scrollFocus === 'boolean' ? options.scrollFocus : false;

      DOM.carousel = options.carousel;
      DOM.slides = [...options.slides];
      DOM.dot.container = typeof options.dot === 'object' && options.dot.container ? options.dot.container : null;
      DOM.dot.template = typeof options.dot === 'object' && options.dot.template ? options.dot.template : null;

      slider.max = DOM.slides.length;
      DOM.dot.container = DOM.dot.container && typeof DOM.dot.container[Symbol.iterator] === 'function' ? [...DOM.dot.container] : DOM.dot.container;

      if (slider.max > 1) {
        let i = 0;
        let DOMNewDot;

        // Hide other slides
        if (_this.animate) {
          gsap.set(DOM.slides.slice(1), { display: 'none', opacity: 0 });
        }

        // Mark first slide as active
        if (DOM.slides[0] instanceof Array) {
          DOM.slides[0].forEach((DOMSlideElement) => {
            DOMSlideElement.classList.add(_this.classes.active);
          });
        } else {
          DOM.slides[0].classList.add(_this.classes.active);
        }

        if (DOM.dot.container) {
          // Multiple dot containers
          if (DOM.dot.container.length) {
            const fills = [];
            // Record each first template dot
            DOM.dot.container.forEach((DOMDotContainer) => {
              if (typeof DOM.dot.all[0] === 'undefined') {
                DOM.dot.all[0] = [];
              }

              // Assumes first child is the templaate
              DOM.dot.all[0].push(DOMDotContainer.children[0]);
              fills.push(DOMDotContainer.children[0].querySelector('.dot__fill'));
            });

            for (i = 1; i < slider.max; i++) {
              DOM.dot.container.forEach((DOMDotContainer, index) => {
                DOMNewDot = DOM.dot.all[0][index].cloneNode(true);
                DOMNewDot.classList.remove(DOM.dot.classes.active);

                DOMDotContainer.append(DOMNewDot);

                if (typeof DOM.dot.all[i] === 'undefined') {
                  DOM.dot.all[i] = [];
                }

                DOM.dot.all[i].push(DOMNewDot);
                fills.push(DOMNewDot.querySelector('.dot__fill'));
              });
            }

            gsap.set(fills, { scaleX: 0 });
            // Single dot container
          } else if (DOM.dot.template) {
            DOM.dot.all.push(DOM.dot.template);

            for (i = 1; i < slider.max; i++) {
              DOMNewDot = DOM.dot.template.cloneNode(true);
              DOMNewDot.classList.remove(DOM.dot.classes.active);

              DOM.dot.container.append(DOMNewDot);
              DOM.dot.all.push(DOMNewDot);
            }

            // Scale down all fills
            gsap.set(DOM.dot.container.querySelectorAll('.dot__fill'), { scaleX: 0 });
          }
        }

        // Assume duplicate handlers are not added
        window.addEventListener('blur', _this.blur);
        _this.eventHandlers.push({ DOM: window, event: 'blur', handler: _this.blur });

        window.addEventListener('focus', this.focus);
        _this.eventHandlers.push({ DOM: window, event: 'focus', handler: _this.focus });
      } else if (DOM.dot.container) {
        // Do not show dots if there is less than one slide
        DOM.dot.container.remove();
      }

      // Add click interaction
      DOM.dot.all.forEach(function (DOMDot, index) {
        const DOMDots = DOMDot;

        function dotClickHandler(e) {
          e.preventDefault();

          _this.pauseTimers(true);

          _this.setCurrent(index);
        }

        // Multiple dot containers
        if (DOMDots instanceof Array) {
          DOMDots.forEach((DOMDot) => {
            DOMDot.addEventListener('click', dotClickHandler);
            _this.eventHandlers.push({ DOM: DOMDot, event: 'click', handler: dotClickHandler });
          });
        } else {
          DOMDot.addEventListener('click', dotClickHandler);
          _this.eventHandlers.push({ DOM: DOMDot, event: 'click', handler: dotClickHandler });
        }
      });

        ScrollTrigger.create({
          trigger: DOM.carousel,
          start: 'top bottom',
          end: 'bottom top',
          onEnter: function () {
            // Start auto progression
            if (_this.auto) {
              _this.start();
            }
          },
          onEnterBack: function () {

            if (_this.auto) {
              _this.start();
            }

          onLeave: function () {

          },
          onLeaveBack: function () {
            _this.stop(false);
          },

        ScrollTrigger.refresh();
      } else {
        // Start auto progression
        if (this.auto) {
          this.start();
        }
      }

      DOM.carousel.addEventListener('click', _this.propagationStop);
      _this.eventHandlers.push({ DOM: DOM.carousel, event: 'click', handler: _this.propagationStop });
    }

    /**
     * @method pauseTimers
     * @description Pauses progression and other timers
     * @param resume {boolean}
     */
    pauseTimers(resume) {
      const _this = this;
      const DOM = _this.DOM;
      const slider = _this.slider;
      const time = _this.time;

      if (time.tween) {
        time.tween.pause();
      }

      if (DOM.dot.all.length) {
        // Update "current" dot in each dot container
        if (DOM.dot.all[slider.current] instanceof Array) {
          DOM.dot.all[slider.current].forEach((DOMDot) => {
            gsap.set(DOMDot.querySelector('.dot__fill'), { scaleX: 0 });
          });
          // Update "current" dot
        } else {
          gsap.set(DOM.dot.all[slider.current].querySelector('.dot__fill'), { scaleX: 0 });
        }
      }

      if (time.resume.timer) {
        clearTimeout(time.resume.timer);
      }

      // Do not resume if auto progression isn't allowed
      if (_this.auto && resume) {
        this.resumeTimers();
      }
    }

    /**
     * @method resumeTimers
     * @description Starts the resumption timer
     * @returns {undefined}
     */
    resumeTimers() {
      const _this = this;
      const time = _this.time;

      if (!_this.auto) {
        return;
      }

      time.resume.timer = setTimeout(function () {
        _this.start();
        time.resume.timer = false;
      }, time.resume.delay * 1000);
    }

    /**
     * @method prev
     * @description Steps carousel forward one step
     */
    next() {
      const _this = this;

      _this.pauseTimers(true);

      _this.setCurrent(_this.slider.current + 1);
    }

    /**
     * @method prev
     * @description Steps carousel back one step
     */
    prev() {
      const _this = this;

      _this.pauseTimers(true);

      _this.setCurrent(_this.slider.current - 1);
    }

    /**
     * @method setCurrent
     * @param index {number} Slide index to go to
     * @returns {undefined}
     */
    setCurrent(index) {
      const _this = this;
      const DOM = this.DOM;
      const slider = this.slider;
      const timeline = new gsap.timeline({
        onComplete: function () {
          // Trigger potential Webflow animations that occur on scroll
          document.dispatchEvent(new Event('scroll', { bubbles: true }));

      index = index >= DOM.slides.length ? index - DOM.slides.length : index;

      // Do not progress if index moves to the current slide
      if (index === slider.current) {
        return;
      }

      if (DOM.dot.container) {
        // Remove active class from dots
        DOM.dot.all.forEach(function (DOMDot) {
          const DOMDots = DOMDot;

          if (DOMDots instanceof Array) {
            DOMDots.forEach((DOMDot) => {
              DOMDot.classList.remove(DOM.dot.classes.active);
            });
          } else {
            DOMDot.classList.remove(DOM.dot.classes.active);
          }
        });

        // Set active dot
        if (DOM.dot.all[index] instanceof Array) {
          const DOMDots = DOM.dot.all[index];

          DOMDots.forEach((DOMDot) => {
            DOMDot.classList.add(DOM.dot.classes.active);
          });
        } else if (DOM.dot.all.length) {
          DOM.dot.all[index].classList.add(DOM.dot.classes.active);
        }
      }

      otherSlides = DOM.slides.filter((DOMSlide, otherIndex) => {
        return otherIndex !== index;
      });

      if (_this.animate) {
        timeline
          .add(() => {
            if (DOM.slides[index] instanceof Array) {
              DOM.slides[index].foreach((DOMSlideElement) => {
                DOMSlideElement.parentElement.append(DOMSlideElement);
              });
            } else {
              DOM.slides[index].parentElement.append(DOM.slides[index]);
            }
          })
          .fromTo(DOM.slides[index], { opacity: 0, display: 'none' }, { opacity: 1, display: 'flex', duration: 0.5 });

        // Assumes slides have no backgrounds
        if (_this.animate.other) {
          otherSlides.forEach((otherSlide) => {
            timeline.to(otherSlide, { opacity: 0, display: 'none', duration: 0.5 }, '-=0.5');

        } else {
          otherSlides.forEach((otherSlide) => {
            timeline.set(otherSlide, { opacity: 0, display: 'none' });

      DOM.slides.forEach((DOMSlide) => {

    /**

    start() {

    /**
     * @method stop
     * @description Stops auto progression
     */
    stop() {
      const time = this.time;

      const DOM = this.DOM;
      const _DOM = {
        fills: [],

      }

        } else if (DOM.dot.all.length) {

    /**
     * @method destroy
     * @description Cleans up event listeners

    destroy() {
      const _this = this;
      const DOM = _this.DOM;

      _this.eventHandlers.forEach((eventHandlerData) => {
